codeFunctions: protected String [ ] readPackageActionPath (final Class actionClass) { Package actionPackage = actionClass.getPackage ();final String actionPackageName = actionPackage.getName ();// 1 - read annotations first String packageActionPathFromAnnotation;mainloop:while (true) { MadvocAction madvocActionAnnotation = actionPackage.getAnnotation (MadvocAction.class);packageActionPathFromAnnotation = madvocActionAnnotation != null?madvocActionAnnotation.value ().trim ():null;if (StringUtil.isEmpty (packageActionPathFromAnnotation)) { packageActionPathFromAnnotation = null;} if (packageActionPathFromAnnotation == null) { // next package String newPackage = actionPackage.getName ();actionPackage = null;while (actionPackage == null) { final int ndx = newPackage.lastIndexOf (' ');if (ndx == - 1) { // end of hierarchy, nothing found break mainloop;} newPackage = newPackage.substring (0,ndx);actionPackage = Packages.of (actionClass.getClassLoader (),newPackage);} } else { // annotation found, register root rootPackages.addRootPackage (actionPackage.getName (),packageActionPathFromAnnotation);break;} } // 2 - read root package String packagePath = rootPackages.findPackagePathForActionPackage (actionPackageName);if (packagePath == null) { return ArraysUtil.array (null,null);} return ArraysUtil.array (StringUtil.stripChar (packagePath,' '),StringUtil.surround (packagePath,StringPool.SLASH));}

codeComment: This method checks if the last modified date of the data is greater than -1 and if the response does not already contain a "Last-Modified" header. If both conditions are met, it compares the "If-Modified-Since" header in the request with the last modified date. If the "If-Modified-Since" header is less than the last modified date, it sets the "Last-Modified" header in the response and sends the response. If the "If-Modified-Since" header is greater than or equal to the last modified date, it resets the response and sets the status to HTTP 304 Not Modified.
codeFunctions: @ Override protected void preResponseCommit () { long lastModified = lastModifiedData.getLastModified ();long ifModifiedSince = request.getDateHeader ("If-Modified-Since");if (lastModified > - 1 &&!response.containsHeader ("Last-Modified")) { if (ifModifiedSince < (lastModified / 1000 * 1000)) { response.setDateHeader ("Last-Modified",lastModified);} else { response.reset ();response.setStatus (HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_MODIFIED);} } }

originalComment: Applies advice on given target class and returns proxy instance.
codeComment: This method applies advice to a given target class. It first checks if the advice for the target class is already cached. If not, it creates a new advice class using a proxy and caches it. Then, it creates a new instance of the advice class, injects the target class into it, and returns the advice instance as the target class type. If an exception occurs during the process, it throws a `ProxettaException`.
codeFunctions: public static < T > T applyAdvice (final Class < T > targetClass) { Class adviceClass = cache.get (targetClass);if (adviceClass == null) { // advice not yet created adviceClass = PROXY_PROXETTA.proxy ().setTarget (targetClass).define ();cache.put (targetClass,adviceClass);} // create new advice instance and injects target instance to it try { Object advice = ClassUtil.newInstance (adviceClass);Field field = adviceClass.getField ("$___target$0");field.set (advice,targetClass);return (T) advice;} catch (Exception ex) { throw new ProxettaException (ex);} }

originalComment: Read the BootstrapMethods bootstrap_methods array binary content and add them as entries of the SymbolTable.
codeComment: This method reads the `bootstrap_methods` attribute from a class file using a `ClassReader`. It calculates the offset and length of the `bootstrap_methods` array, then iterates over each bootstrap method to extract its reference, number of arguments, and hash code. The hash code is computed by XORing the hash codes of the bootstrap method reference and each bootstrap argument. The extracted information is added to a symbol table with the tag `Symbol.BOOTSTRAP_METHOD_TAG`.
codeFunctions: private void copyBootstrapMethods (final ClassReader classReader,final char [ ] charBuffer) { // Find attributOffset of the 'bootstrap_methods' array. byte [ ] inputBytes = classReader.b;int currentAttributeOffset = classReader.getFirstAttributeOffset ();for (int i = classReader.readUnsignedShort (currentAttributeOffset - 2);i > 0;-- i) { String attributeName = classReader.readUTF8 (currentAttributeOffset,charBuffer);if (Constants.BOOTSTRAP_METHODS.equals (attributeName)) { bootstrapMethodCount = classReader.readUnsignedShort (currentAttributeOffset + 6);break;} currentAttributeOffset += 6 + classReader.readInt (currentAttributeOffset + 2);} if (bootstrapMethodCount > 0) { // Compute the offset and the length of the BootstrapMethods 'bootstrap_methods' array. int bootstrapMethodsOffset = currentAttributeOffset + 8;int bootstrapMethodsLength = classReader.readInt (currentAttributeOffset + 2) - 2;bootstrapMethods = new ByteVector (bootstrapMethodsLength);bootstrapMethods.putByteArray (inputBytes,bootstrapMethodsOffset,bootstrapMethodsLength);// Add each bootstrap method in the symbol table entries. int currentOffset = bootstrapMethodsOffset;for (int i = 0;i < bootstrapMethodCount;i ++) { int offset = currentOffset - bootstrapMethodsOffset;int bootstrapMethodRef = classReader.readUnsignedShort (currentOffset);currentOffset += 2;int numBootstrapArguments = classReader.readUnsignedShort (currentOffset);currentOffset += 2;int hashCode = classReader.readConst (bootstrapMethodRef,charBuffer).hashCode ();while (numBootstrapArguments -- > 0) { int bootstrapArgument = classReader.readUnsignedShort (currentOffset);currentOffset += 2;hashCode ^= classReader.readConst (bootstrapArgument,charBuffer).hashCode ();} add (new Entry (i,Symbol.BOOTSTRAP_METHOD_TAG,offset,hashCode & 0x7FFFFFFF));} } }

originalComment: Writes content to the output stream using progress listener to track the sending progress.
codeComment: This method writes data to an `OutputStream` while also notifying a `HttpProgressListener` about the progress. It handles both `FastByteBuffer` and `Uploadable` objects, which can be either byte arrays or streams, respectively. The method calculates the number of bytes to send in each chunk based on the `callbackSize` and the current step, ensuring that the total number of bytes sent is tracked and reported to the listener.
codeFunctions: public void writeTo (final OutputStream out,final HttpProgressListener progressListener) throws IOException { // start final int size = size ();final int callbackSize = progressListener.callbackSize (size);int count = 0;// total count int step = 0;// step is offset in current chunk progressListener.transferred (count);// loop for (Object o:list) { if (o instanceof FastByteBuffer) { FastByteBuffer fastByteBuffer = (FastByteBuffer) o;byte [ ] bytes = fastByteBuffer.toArray ();int offset = 0;while (offset < bytes.length) { // calc the remaining sending chunk size int chunk = callbackSize - step;// check if this chunk size fits the bytes array if (offset + chunk > bytes.length) { chunk = bytes.length - offset;} // writes the chunk out.write (bytes,offset,chunk);offset += chunk;step += chunk;count += chunk;// listener if (step >= callbackSize) { progressListener.transferred (count);step -= callbackSize;} } } else if (o instanceof Uploadable) { Uploadable uploadable = (Uploadable) o;InputStream inputStream = uploadable.openInputStream ();int remaining = uploadable.getSize ();try { while (remaining > 0) { // calc the remaining sending chunk size int chunk = callbackSize - step;// check if this chunk size fits the remaining size if (chunk > remaining) { chunk = remaining;} // writes remaining chunk StreamUtil.copy (inputStream,out,chunk);remaining -= chunk;step += chunk;count += chunk;// listener if (step >= callbackSize) { progressListener.transferred (count);step -= callbackSize;} } } finally { StreamUtil.close (inputStream);} } } // end if (step != 0) { progressListener.transferred (count);} }

codeFunctions: ReceivedEmail [ ] receiveMessages (final EmailFilter filter,final Flags flagsToSet,final Flags flagsToUnset,final boolean envelope,final Consumer < Message [ ] > processedMessageConsumer) { useAndOpenFolderIfNotSet ();final Message [ ] messages;try { if (filter == null) { messages = folder.getMessages ();} else { messages = folder.search (filter.getSearchTerm ());} if (messages.length == 0) { return ReceivedEmail.EMPTY_ARRAY;} if (envelope) { final FetchProfile fetchProfile = new FetchProfile ();fetchProfile.add (FetchProfile.Item.ENVELOPE);fetchProfile.add (FetchProfile.Item.FLAGS);folder.fetch (messages,fetchProfile);} // process messages final ReceivedEmail [ ] emails = new ReceivedEmail [ messages.length ];for (int i = 0;i < messages.length;i ++) { final Message msg = messages [ i ];// we need to parse message BEFORE flags are set! emails [ i ] = new ReceivedEmail (msg,envelope,attachmentStorage);if (!EmailUtil.isEmptyFlags (flagsToSet)) { emails [ i ].flags (flagsToSet);msg.setFlags (flagsToSet,true);} if (!EmailUtil.isEmptyFlags (flagsToUnset)) { emails [ i ].flags ().remove (flagsToUnset);msg.setFlags (flagsToUnset,false);} if (EmailUtil.isEmptyFlags (flagsToSet) &&!emails [ i ].isSeen ()) { msg.setFlag (Flags.Flag.SEEN,false);} } if (processedMessageConsumer != null) { processedMessageConsumer.accept (messages);} // if messages were marked to be deleted, we need to expunge the folder if (!EmailUtil.isEmptyFlags (flagsToSet)) { if (flagsToSet.contains (Flags.Flag.DELETED)) { folder.expunge ();} } return emails;} catch (final MessagingException msgexc) { throw new MailException ("Failed to fetch messages",msgexc);} }

originalComment: Initialize the cipher using the key and the tweak value.
codeComment: This method initializes the threefish cipher with a key and tweak. It checks if the key length has changed and updates the internal state accordingly. It then sets up arrays for intermediate values and the extended key schedule.
codeFunctions: public void init (final long [ ] key,final long [ ] tweak) { final int newNw = key.length;// only create new arrays if the value of N{w} changes (different key size) if (nw != newNw) { nw = newNw;switch (nw) { case WORDS_4:pi = PI4;rpi = RPI4;r = R4;break;case WORDS_8:pi = PI8;rpi = RPI8;r = R8;break;case WORDS_16:pi = PI16;rpi = RPI16;r = R16;break;default:throw new RuntimeException ("Invalid threefish key");} this.k = new long [ nw + 1 ];// instantiation of these fields here for performance reasons vd = new long [ nw ];// v is the intermediate value v{d} at round d ed = new long [ nw ];// ed is the value of e{d} at round d fd = new long [ nw ];// fd is the value of f{d} at round d ksd = new long [ nw ];// ksd is the value of k{s} at round d } System.arraycopy (key,0,this.k,0,key.length);long knw = EXTENDED_KEY_SCHEDULE_CONST;for (int i = 0;i < nw;i ++) { knw ^= this.k [ i ];} this.k [ nw ] = knw;// set tweak values t [ 0 ] = tweak [ 0 ];t [ 1 ] = tweak [ 1 ];t [ 2 ] = t [ 0 ] ^ t [ 1 ];}

originalComment: Implementation of the MIX function.
codeComment: The method `mix` takes two final integer parameters `j` and `d`. It calculates the sum of the first two elements of the array `x` and assigns it to the first element of the array `y`. It then performs a left rotation on the element at index `d % DEPTH_OF_D_IN_R` in the array `r` and uses it to shift the second element of `x` to the left. The result is then XORed with the first element of `y`.
codeFunctions: private void mix (final int j,final int d) { y [ 0 ] = x [ 0 ] + x [ 1 ];final long rotl = r [ d % DEPTH_OF_D_IN_R ] [ j ];// java left rotation for a long y [ 1 ] = (x [ 1 ] << rotl) | (x [ 1 ] >>> (Long.SIZE - rotl));y [ 1 ] ^= y [ 0 ];}

originalComment: Implementation of the un - MIX function.
codeComment:
The method `demix` takes two integer parameters `j` and `d`. It performs the following operations:

1. XORs the elements at indices 0 and 1 of the array `y`.
2. Calculates a right rotation value `rotr` using the modulus operation on the element at index `d % DEPTH_OF_D_IN_R` in the 2D array `r` and the index `j`.
3. Performs a right shift on the element at index 1 of the array `y` by `Long.SIZE - rotr` bits and combines it with the result of a left shift by `rotr` bits using bitwise OR.
4. Updates the element at index 0 of the array `x` by subtracting the value at index 1 of the array `x` from the value at index 1 of the array `y`.
codeFunctions: private void demix (final int j,final int d) { y [ 1 ] ^= y [ 0 ];final long rotr = r [ d % DEPTH_OF_D_IN_R ] [ j ];// NOTE performance: darn, creation on stack! // right shift x [ 1 ] = (y [ 1 ] << (Long.SIZE - rotr)) | (y [ 1 ] >>> rotr);x [ 0 ] = y [ 0 ] - x [ 1 ];}

codeComment: This method reads data from an input stream into a byte array. It uses a `ByteArrayOutputStream` to accumulate the data. The method throws an `IOException` if the input stream is null. codeFunctions: private static byte [ ] readStream (final InputStream inputStream,final boolean close) throws IOException { if (inputStream == null) { throw new IOException ("Class not found");} try { ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream ();byte [ ] data = new byte [ INPUT_STREAM_DATA_CHUNK_SIZE ];int bytesRead;while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read (data,0,data.length)) != - 1) { outputStream.write (data,0,bytesRead);} outputStream.flush ();return outputStream.toByteArray ();} finally { if (close) { inputStream.close ();} } }

originalComment: Returns the label corresponding to the given bytecode offset.The default implementation of this method creates a label for the given offset if it has not been already created.
codeComment: This method reads a label from an array of labels at a given bytecode offset. If the label at the specified offset is null, it creates a new label and assigns it to that position in the array. The method then returns the label at the specified offset.
codeFunctions: protected Label readLabel (final int bytecodeOffset,final Label [ ] labels) { if (labels [ bytecodeOffset ] == null) { labels [ bytecodeOffset ] = new Label ();} return labels [ bytecodeOffset ];}

originalComment: Returns the bytecode offset corresponding to the specified JVMS type_annotation structure or - 1 if there is no such type_annotation of if it does not have a bytecode offset.
codeComment: The method `getTypeAnnotationBytecodeOffset` takes an array of type annotation offsets and an index as input. It checks if the type annotation offsets array is null or if the index is out of bounds. If either condition is true, it returns -1. Otherwise, it reads the unsigned short value at the offset specified by the index plus one and returns it.
codeFunctions: private int getTypeAnnotationBytecodeOffset (final int [ ] typeAnnotationOffsets,final int typeAnnotationIndex) { if (typeAnnotationOffsets == null || typeAnnotationIndex >= typeAnnotationOffsets.length || readByte (typeAnnotationOffsets [ typeAnnotationIndex ]) < TypeReference.INSTANCEOF) { return - 1;} return readUnsignedShort (typeAnnotationOffsets [ typeAnnotationIndex ] + 1);}

originalComment: Reads the element values of a JVMS annotation structure and makes the given visitor visit them.This method can also be used to read the values of the JVMS array_value field of an annotation s element_value.
codeComment: This method reads element values from an annotation and processes them using an `AnnotationVisitor`. It handles both named and array values, updating the current offset as it processes each element. If an `AnnotationVisitor` is provided, it calls `visitEnd()` at the end.
codeFunctions: private int readElementValues (final AnnotationVisitor annotationVisitor,final int annotationOffset,final boolean named,final char [ ] charBuffer) { int currentOffset = annotationOffset;// Read the num_element_value_pairs field (or num_values field for an array_value). int numElementValuePairs = readUnsignedShort (currentOffset);currentOffset += 2;if (named) { // Parse the element_value_pairs array. while (numElementValuePairs -- > 0) { String elementName = readUTF8 (currentOffset,charBuffer);currentOffset = readElementValue (annotationVisitor,currentOffset + 2,elementName,charBuffer);} } else { // Parse the array_value array. while (numElementValuePairs -- > 0) { currentOffset = readElementValue (annotationVisitor,currentOffset,/* named = */ null,charBuffer);} } if (annotationVisitor != null) { annotationVisitor.visitEnd ();} return currentOffset;}

originalComment: Reads a JVMS verification_type_info structure and stores it at the given index in the given array.
codeComment: This method reads a verification type information from a byte array and populates an array of integers with the corresponding opcode values. It handles different types of frame items such as TOP, INTEGER, FLOAT, DOUBLE, LONG, NULL, UNINITIALIZED_THIS, OBJECT, and UNINITIALIZED. The method uses a switch statement to determine the type of frame item and updates the corresponding index in the frame array with the appropriate opcode. If an unknown tag is encountered, it throws an IllegalArgumentException.
codeFunctions: private int readVerificationTypeInfo (final int verificationTypeInfoOffset,final Object [ ] frame,final int index,final char [ ] charBuffer,final Label [ ] labels) { int currentOffset = verificationTypeInfoOffset;int tag = b [ currentOffset ++ ] & 0xFF;switch (tag) { case Frame.ITEM_TOP:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.TOP;break;case Frame.ITEM_INTEGER:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.INTEGER;break;case Frame.ITEM_FLOAT:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.FLOAT;break;case Frame.ITEM_DOUBLE:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.DOUBLE;break;case Frame.ITEM_LONG:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.LONG;break;case Frame.ITEM_NULL:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.NULL;break;case Frame.ITEM_UNINITIALIZED_THIS:frame [ index ] = Opcodes.UNINITIALIZED_THIS;break;case Frame.ITEM_OBJECT:frame [ index ] = readClass (currentOffset,charBuffer);currentOffset += 2;break;case Frame.ITEM_UNINITIALIZED:frame [ index ] = createLabel (readUnsignedShort (currentOffset),labels);currentOffset += 2;break;default:throw new IllegalArgumentException ();} return currentOffset;}

originalComment: Reads the BootstrapMethods attribute to compute the offset of each bootstrap method.
codeComment: This method reads the BootstrapMethods attribute from a class file. It first initializes a character buffer and reads the offset of the first attribute. It then iterates over each attribute, checking if it is a BootstrapMethods attribute. If it is, it reads the number of bootstrap methods and creates an array of offsets for each method. It then iterates over each method, reading the bootstrap method reference and number of arguments, and skipping the bootstrap arguments array. Finally, it returns the array of bootstrap method offsets. If no BootstrapMethods attribute is found, it returns null.
codeFunctions: private int [ ] readBootstrapMethodsAttribute (final int maxStringLength) { char [ ] charBuffer = new char [ maxStringLength ];int currentAttributeOffset = getFirstAttributeOffset ();int [ ] currentBootstrapMethodOffsets = null;for (int i = readUnsignedShort (currentAttributeOffset - 2);i > 0;-- i) { // Read the attribute_info's attribute_name and attribute_length fields. String attributeName = readUTF8 (currentAttributeOffset,charBuffer);int attributeLength = readInt (currentAttributeOffset + 2);currentAttributeOffset += 6;if (Constants.BOOTSTRAP_METHODS.equals (attributeName)) { // Read the num_bootstrap_methods field and create an array of this size. currentBootstrapMethodOffsets = new int [ readUnsignedShort (currentAttributeOffset) ];// Compute and store the offset of each 'bootstrap_methods' array field entry. int currentBootstrapMethodOffset = currentAttributeOffset + 2;for (int j = 0;j < currentBootstrapMethodOffsets.length;++ j) { currentBootstrapMethodOffsets [ j ] = currentBootstrapMethodOffset;// Skip the bootstrap_method_ref and num_bootstrap_arguments fields (2 bytes each), // as well as the bootstrap_arguments array field (of size num_bootstrap_arguments * 2). currentBootstrapMethodOffset += 4 + readUnsignedShort (currentBootstrapMethodOffset + 2) * 2;} return currentBootstrapMethodOffsets;} currentAttributeOffset += attributeLength;} return null;}

originalComment: Inspects all declared constructors of a target type.
codeComment: This method inspects the constructors of a given class and returns an array of `CtorDescriptor` objects. It retrieves the declared constructors of the class, creates a `CtorDescriptor` for each constructor, and stores them in an array. If a default constructor is found, it is stored in the `defaultCtor` variable.
codeFunctions: protected CtorDescriptor [ ] inspectConstructors () { Class type = classDescriptor.getType ();Constructor [ ] ctors = type.getDeclaredConstructors ();CtorDescriptor [ ] allCtors = new CtorDescriptor [ ctors.length ];for (int i = 0;i < ctors.length;i ++) { Constructor ctor = ctors [ i ];CtorDescriptor ctorDescriptor = createCtorDescriptor (ctor);allCtors [ i ] = ctorDescriptor;if (ctorDescriptor.isDefault ()) { defaultCtor = ctorDescriptor;} } return allCtors;}

originalComment: Finds constructor description that matches given argument types.
codeComment: This method iterates over a list of `CtorDescriptor` objects, checking if any of them have the same parameter types as the provided arguments. If a match is found, it returns the corresponding `CtorDescriptor`. If no match is found after checking all descriptors, it returns `null`.
codeFunctions: public CtorDescriptor getCtorDescriptor (final Class ... args) { ctors:for (CtorDescriptor ctorDescriptor:allCtors) { Class [ ] arg = ctorDescriptor.getParameters ();if (arg.length != args.length) { continue;} for (int j = 0;j < arg.length;j ++) { if (arg [ j ] != args [ j ]) { continue ctors;} } return ctorDescriptor;} return null;}

originalComment: Converts array value to array.
codeComment: This method converts an array of objects to an array of longs. If the input array is primitive, it calls a helper method `convertPrimitiveArrayToArray`. Otherwise, it converts each object in the array to a long using the `convertType` method and stores the results in a new long array.
codeFunctions: protected long [ ] convertArrayToArray (final Object value) { final Class valueComponentType = value.getClass ().getComponentType ();final long [ ] result;if (valueComponentType.isPrimitive ()) { result = convertPrimitiveArrayToArray (value,valueComponentType);} else { // convert object array to target array final Object [ ] array = (Object [ ]) value;result = new long [ array.length ];for (int i = 0;i < array.length;i ++) { result [ i ] = convertType (array [ i ]);} } return result;}

originalComment: Initializes Decora filter.Loads manager and parser from init parameters.

It attempts to load the classes specified by the parameters using ClassLoaderUtil and ClassUtil, and handles any exceptions that occur during the loading process. If the parameters are not provided, it creates the DecoraManager and DecoraParser instances using the createDecoraManager and createDecoraParser methods, respectively. The method also sets the cached flag based on the value of the PARAM_DECORA_CACHE parameter.

originalComment: Registers file consumer
codeComment: This method adds a `Consumer<File>` to a list of consumers. If the list is null, it initializes it with the provided consumer.

originalComment: Specifies the search path.Throws an exception if URI is invalid.
codeComment: This method takes a URI as input, attempts to create a File object from it, and adds the file to a list of paths. If an exception occurs during the creation of the File object, it throws a FindFileException with an error message indicating the URI and the exception. The method returns the current instance of the class.
codeFunctions: public FindFile searchPath (final URI searchPath) { File file;try { file = new File (searchPath);} catch (Exception ex) { throw new FindFileException ("URI error: " + searchPath,ex);} addPath (file);return this;}

originalComment: Adds existing search path to the file list.Non existing files are ignored.If path is a folder it will be scanned for all files.
codeComment: This method adds a file path to a list if the path exists and the list is not null.

originalComment: Finds all files and returns list of founded files.
codeComment: This method retrieves all files from a directory and returns them as a list. It uses a while loop to iterate over each file obtained from the `nextFile()` method, adding each file to the `allFiles` list. Finally, it returns the list of all files.
codeFunctions: public List < File > findAll () { List < File > allFiles = new ArrayList <> ();File file;while ((file = nextFile ()) != null) { allFiles.add (file);} return allFiles;}

originalComment: Initializes file walking.Separates input files and folders.
codeComment: The `init` method initializes the `rules` object to detect the mode, creates two linked lists (`todoFiles` and `todoFolders`), and processes a list of paths (`pathList`). If `pathList` is null, it initializes it as an empty list. If `pathListOriginal` is null, it clones `pathList` and stores it in `pathListOriginal`. It then creates an array of file paths from `pathList`, removes files from `pathList`, and adds a `FilesIterator` to `todoFiles` if there are any files.
codeFunctions: protected void init () { rules.detectMode ();todoFiles = new LinkedList <> ();todoFolders = new LinkedList <> ();if (pathList == null) { pathList = new LinkedList <> ();return;} if (pathListOriginal == null) { pathListOriginal = (LinkedList < File >) pathList.clone ();} String [ ] files = new String [ pathList.size () ];int index = 0;Iterator < File > iterator = pathList.iterator ();while (iterator.hasNext ()) { File file = iterator.next ();if (file.isFile ()) { files [ index ++ ] = file.getAbsolutePath ();iterator.remove ();} } if (index != 0) { FilesIterator filesIterator = new FilesIterator (files);todoFiles.add (filesIterator);} }

originalComment: Returns file walking iterator.
codeComment: This code defines a custom iterator for a collection of files. The iterator uses a private field `nextFile` to keep track of the next file to be returned. The `hasNext` method checks if there is a next file by calling `nextFile()`, and the `next` method returns the next file if it exists, otherwise it throws a `NoSuchElementException`. The `remove` method is not implemented and throws an `UnsupportedOperationException`.
codeFunctions: @ Override public Iterator < File > iterator () { return new Iterator < File > () { private File nextFile;@ Override public boolean hasNext () { nextFile = nextFile ();return nextFile != null;} @ Override public File next () { if (nextFile == null) { throw new NoSuchElementException ();} return nextFile;} @ Override public void remove () { throw new UnsupportedOperationException ();} };}

originalComment: Resolves bean s auto - wire flag from the annotation.Returns default auto - wire if annotation doesn t exist.
codeComment: The method `resolveBeanWiringMode` takes a class type as input and returns a `WiringMode` enum value. It retrieves the `PetiteBean` annotation from the class and returns the `wiring` field if the annotation is present, otherwise it returns `WiringMode.DEFAULT`.
codeFunctions: public WiringMode resolveBeanWiringMode (final Class type) { PetiteBean petiteBean = ((Class <?>) type).getAnnotation (PetiteBean.class);return petiteBean != null?petiteBean.wiring ():WiringMode.DEFAULT;}

originalComment: Resolves bean s name from bean annotation or type name.May be used for resolving bean name of base type during registration of bean subclass.
codeComment: This method resolves a bean name based on annotations and class properties. It first checks for a `PetiteBean` annotation on the given class. If found, it uses the value from the annotation. If not, it checks if `useLongTypeName` is true and uses the full class name; otherwise, it uses the uncapitalized simple class name.
codeFunctions: public String resolveBeanName (final Class type,final boolean useLongTypeName) { PetiteBean petiteBean = ((Class <?>) type).getAnnotation (PetiteBean.class);String name = null;if (petiteBean != null) { name = petiteBean.value ().trim ();} if ((name == null) || (name.length () == 0)) { if (useLongTypeName) { name = type.getName ();} else { name = StringUtil.uncapitalize (type.getSimpleName ());} } return name;}

originalComment: Returns a writer.
codeComment: This method returns a PrintWriter object. If the outWriter is null, it checks if outStream is not null. If outStream is not null, it throws an IllegalStateException. If outStream is null, it creates a FastCharArrayWriter and a PrintWriter. The PrintWriter is set to close the FastCharArrayWriter when closed, to prevent the reference to the FastCharArrayWriter from being removed. The method returns the PrintWriter.
codeFunctions: public PrintWriter getWriter () { if (outWriter == null) { if (outStream != null) { throw new IllegalStateException ("Can't call getWriter() after getOutputStream()");} bufferedWriter = new FastCharArrayWriter ();outWriter = new PrintWriter (bufferedWriter) { @ Override public void close () { // do not close the print writer after rendering // since it will remove reference to bufferedWriter } };} return outWriter;}

originalComment: Returns a servlet output stream.
codeComment: This method returns a `ServletOutputStream` for writing binary data to the response. If the `outStream` is not already initialized, it creates a `FastByteArrayServletOutputStream` and assigns it to `outStream`. If `outWriter` is already initialized, it throws an `IllegalStateException` because both `getOutputStream()` and `getWriter()` cannot be called after each other.
codeFunctions: public ServletOutputStream getOutputStream () { if (outStream == null) { if (outWriter != null) { throw new IllegalStateException ("Can't call getOutputStream() after getWriter()");} bufferOutputStream = new FastByteArrayServletOutputStream ();outStream = bufferOutputStream;} return outStream;}

originalComment: Returns the binary name of the class corresponding to this type.This method must not be used on method types.
codeComment: This method returns the class name of the current object based on its type. It handles different types such as void, boolean, char, byte, short, int, float, long, double, array, object, and internal. For arrays, it constructs the class name by appending "[]" for each dimension. For objects and internal types, it returns the substring of the value buffer between valueBegin and valueEnd, replacing spaces with nothing. If the type is not recognized, it throws an AssertionError.
codeFunctions: public String getClassName () { switch (sort) { case VOID:return "void";case BOOLEAN:return "boolean";case CHAR:return "char";case BYTE:return "byte";case SHORT:return "short";case INT:return "int";case FLOAT:return "float";case LONG:return "long";case DOUBLE:return "double";case ARRAY:StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder (getElementType ().getClassName ());for (int i = getDimensions ();i > 0;-- i) { stringBuilder.append ("[]");} return stringBuilder.toString ();case OBJECT:case INTERNAL:return valueBuffer.substring (valueBegin,valueEnd).replace (' ',' ');default:throw new AssertionError ();} }

originalComment: Returns the descriptor corresponding to the given constructor.
codeComment: This method generates a string representation of the constructor descriptor for a given `Constructor` object. It uses a `StringBuilder` to construct the descriptor, which includes the parameter types of the constructor. The method iterates over the parameter types, appending their descriptors to the `StringBuilder`. Finally, it appends the closing parenthesis and the return type "V" to complete the descriptor.
codeFunctions: public static String getConstructorDescriptor (final Constructor <?> constructor) { StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder ();stringBuilder.append (' ');Class <?> [ ] parameters = constructor.getParameterTypes ();for (Class <?> parameter:parameters) { appendDescriptor (parameter,stringBuilder);} return stringBuilder.append (")V").toString ();}

originalComment: Returns the descriptor corresponding to the given argument and return types.
codeComment: This method generates a method descriptor string from a return type and a list of argument types. It uses a `StringBuilder` to construct the descriptor by appending the descriptors of each argument type followed by the return type descriptor.
codeFunctions: public static String getMethodDescriptor (final Type returnType,final Type ... argumentTypes) { StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder ();stringBuilder.append (' ');for (Type argumentType:argumentTypes) { argumentType.appendDescriptor (stringBuilder);} stringBuilder.append (' ');returnType.appendDescriptor (stringBuilder);return stringBuilder.toString ();}

originalComment: Returns the descriptor corresponding to the given method.
codeComment: This method generates a method descriptor string for a given Java method. It constructs the descriptor by appending the parameter types and the return type of the method, separated by spaces. The `appendDescriptor` method is used to convert each class to its descriptor string.
codeFunctions: public static String getMethodDescriptor (final Method method) { StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder ();stringBuilder.append (' ');Class <?> [ ] parameters = method.getParameterTypes ();for (Class <?> parameter:parameters) { appendDescriptor (parameter,stringBuilder);} stringBuilder.append (' ');appendDescriptor (method.getReturnType (),stringBuilder);return stringBuilder.toString ();}

originalComment: Appends the descriptor corresponding to this type to the given string buffer.
codeComment: This method appends a descriptor to a `StringBuilder` based on the value of the `sort` variable. If `sort` is `OBJECT`, it appends the substring of `valueBuffer` from `valueBegin - 1` to `valueEnd + 1`. If `sort` is `INTERNAL`, it appends a space, the substring from `valueBegin` to `valueEnd`, and another space. Otherwise, it appends the substring from `valueBegin` to `valueEnd` directly.
codeFunctions: private void appendDescriptor (final StringBuilder stringBuilder) { if (sort == OBJECT) { stringBuilder.append (valueBuffer,valueBegin - 1,valueEnd + 1);} else if (sort == INTERNAL) { stringBuilder.append (' ').append (valueBuffer,valueBegin,valueEnd).append (' ');} else { stringBuilder.append (valueBuffer,valueBegin,valueEnd);} }

originalComment: Returns the size of values of this type.This method must not be used for method types.
codeComment: The method `getSize` returns the size of an object based on its type. It uses a switch statement to determine the size of the object and throws an `AssertionError` if the type is not recognized.
codeFunctions: public int getSize () { switch (sort) { case VOID:return 0;case BOOLEAN:case CHAR:case BYTE:case SHORT:case INT:case FLOAT:case ARRAY:case OBJECT:case INTERNAL:return 1;case LONG:case DOUBLE:return 2;default:throw new AssertionError ();} }

originalComment: Computes the size of the arguments and of the return value of a method.
codeComment: This method calculates the size of the arguments and return type in a method descriptor string. It iterates through the string, counting the number of argument types and their sizes, and then calculates the total size by shifting the argument size left by 2 bits and adding the return size.
codeFunctions: public static int getArgumentsAndReturnSizes (final String methodDescriptor) { int argumentsSize = 1;// Skip the first character, which is always a '('. int currentOffset = 1;int currentChar = methodDescriptor.charAt (currentOffset);// Parse the argument types and compute their size, one at a each loop iteration. while (currentChar != ' ') { if (currentChar == ' ' || currentChar == ' ') { currentOffset ++;argumentsSize += 2;} else { while (methodDescriptor.charAt (currentOffset) == ' ') { currentOffset ++;} if (methodDescriptor.charAt (currentOffset ++) == ' ') { // Skip the argument descriptor content. currentOffset = methodDescriptor.indexOf (' ',currentOffset) + 1;} argumentsSize += 1;} currentChar = methodDescriptor.charAt (currentOffset);} currentChar = methodDescriptor.charAt (currentOffset + 1);if (currentChar == ' ') { return argumentsSize << 2;} else { int returnSize = (currentChar == ' ' || currentChar == ' ')?2:1;return argumentsSize << 2 | returnSize;} }

originalComment: Modify the transaction associated with the target object such that the only possible outcome of the transaction is to roll back the transaction.
codeComment: This method sets the transaction to rollback only if it is not in a no-transaction state and the current status is not already marked for rollback or active. If the transaction is not in a valid state, it throws a JtxException. If the transaction is in a valid state, it sets the rollback cause to the provided Throwable and updates the status to STATUS_MARKED_ROLLBACK.
codeFunctions: public void setRollbackOnly (final Throwable th) { if (!isNoTransaction ()) { if ((status != STATUS_MARKED_ROLLBACK) && (status != STATUS_ACTIVE)) { throw new JtxException ("TNo active TX that can be marked as rollback only");} } rollbackCause = th;status = STATUS_MARKED_ROLLBACK;}

originalComment: Performs either commit or rollback on all transaction resources.
codeComment: This method handles the commit or rollback of a transaction based on the input parameter `doCommit`. It logs the action, checks for forced rollbacks, ensures the transaction is active, and commits or rolls back all resources accordingly.
codeFunctions: protected void commitOrRollback (boolean doCommit) { if (log.isDebugEnabled ()) { if (doCommit) { log.debug ("Commit JTX");} else { log.debug ("Rollback JTX");} } boolean forcedRollback = false;if (!isNoTransaction ()) { if (isRollbackOnly ()) { if (doCommit) { doCommit = false;forcedRollback = true;} } else if (!isActive ()) { if (isCompleted ()) { throw new JtxException ("TX is already completed, commit or rollback should be called once per TX");} throw new JtxException ("No active TX to " + (doCommit?"commit":"rollback"));} } if (doCommit) { commitAllResources ();} else { rollbackAllResources (forcedRollback);} }

originalComment: Rollbacks all attached resources.Resource will be closed.and detached from this transaction.If exception occurs it will be rethrown at the end.
codeComment: This method rolls back all resources associated with a transaction, sets the transaction status to "rolling back", and then removes the transaction from the transaction manager. If any resource fails to rollback, it sets the transaction status to "unknown" and throws a JtxException. If the transaction was marked as rollback-only, it throws a JtxException with a specific message.
codeFunctions: protected void rollbackAllResources (final boolean wasForced) { status = STATUS_ROLLING_BACK;Exception lastException = null;Iterator < JtxResource > it = resources.iterator ();while (it.hasNext ()) { JtxResource resource = it.next ();try { resource.rollbackTransaction ();} catch (Exception ex) { lastException = ex;} finally { it.remove ();} } txManager.removeTransaction (this);status = STATUS_ROLLEDBACK;if (lastException != null) { status = STATUS_UNKNOWN;throw new JtxException ("Rollback failed: one or more TX resources couldn't rollback a TX",lastException);} if (wasForced) { throw new JtxException ("TX rolled back because it has been marked as rollback-only",rollbackCause);} }

originalComment: Requests a resource.If resource is not found it will be created and new transaction will be started on it.
codeComment: This method is a generic method that requests a resource of type `E` from a transaction manager. It first checks if the transaction is completed, marked as rollback only, or not active. If any of these conditions are true, it throws a `JtxException`. If the transaction is active, it checks if the maximum number of resources per transaction has been reached. If not, it looks up the resource manager for the given resource type, starts a new transaction, and adds the resource to the list of resources. If the resource is not found, it throws a `JtxException`. Otherwise, it returns the resource.
codeFunctions: public < E > E requestResource (final Class < E > resourceType) { if (isCompleted ()) { throw new JtxException ("TX is already completed, resource are not available after commit or rollback");} if (isRollbackOnly ()) { throw new JtxException ("TX is marked as rollback only, resource are not available",rollbackCause);} if (!isNoTransaction () &&!isActive ()) { throw new JtxException ("Resources are not available since TX is not active");} checkTimeout ();E resource = lookupResource (resourceType);if (resource == null) { int maxResources = txManager.getMaxResourcesPerTransaction ();if ((maxResources != - 1) && (resources.size () >= maxResources)) { throw new JtxException ("TX already has attached max. number of resources");} JtxResourceManager < E > resourceManager = txManager.lookupResourceManager (resourceType);resource = resourceManager.beginTransaction (mode,isActive ());resources.add (new JtxResource <> (this,resourceManager,resource));} return resource;}

originalComment: Writes stored name to JSON string.Cleans storage.
codeComment: This method checks if the stack is pushed, if there is a comma, writes a comma if necessary, retrieves the name, clears the pushed name, sets the pushed flag to false, and writes the name.
codeFunctions: protected void popName () { if (isPushed) { if (pushedComma) { writeComma ();} String name = pushedName;pushedName = null;isPushed = false;writeName (name);} }

originalComment: Write a quoted and escaped value to the output.
codeComment: The method `writeString` takes a string `value` as input and writes it to a stream, escaping special characters as necessary. It uses a `switch` statement to handle different characters, including spaces, and uses the `unicode` method to handle ISO control characters.
codeFunctions: public void writeString (final String value) { popName ();write (StringPool.QUOTE);int len = value.length ();for (int i = 0;i < len;i ++) { char c = value.charAt (i);switch (c) { case ' ':write ("\\\"");break;case ' ':write ("\\\\");break;case ' ':if (strictStringEncoding) { write ("\\/");} else { write (c);} break;case ' ':write ("\\b");break;case ' ':write ("\\f");break;case ' ':write ("\\n");break;case ' ':write ("\\r");break;case ' ':write ("\\t");break;default:if (Character.isISOControl (c)) { unicode (c);} else { write (c);} } } write (StringPool.QUOTE);}

originalComment: Writes unicode representation of a character.
codeComment: This method takes a character `c` as input and writes its Unicode representation to the output. It first writes the escape sequence `\\u` to indicate that the following four characters will represent the Unicode code point of the input character. Then, it converts the character to an integer `n` and iterates over four times, extracting the four most significant bits of `n` at each iteration, converting them to a hexadecimal character using the `CharUtil.int2hex` method, and writing the hexadecimal character to the output.
codeFunctions: protected void unicode (final char c) { write ("\\u");int n = c;for (int i = 0;i < 4;++ i) { int digit = (n & 0xf000) >> 12;char hex = CharUtil.int2hex (digit);write (hex);n <<= 4;} }

originalComment: Finds very last index of given element in inclusive index range.Returns negative value if element is not found.
codeComment: This method performs a binary search to find the last occurrence of a value in a sorted array. It takes two parameters, `low` and `high`, which define the current search range. The method initializes `ndx` to -1, which will store the index of the last occurrence of the value if found. It then enters a while loop that continues as long as `low` is less than or equal to `high`. Inside the loop, it calculates the middle index `mid` and uses the `compare` method to determine the relationship between the middle element and the target value. If the `compare` method returns a value greater than 0, it means the target value is to the right of `mid`, so the search range is updated to `low` to `mid - 1`. If the `compare` method returns 0, it means the target value is found at `mid`, and `ndx` is updated to `mid`. If the `compare` method returns a value less than 0, it means the target value is to the left of `mid`, so the search range is updated to `mid + 1` to `high`. After the loop, if `ndx` is still -1, it means the target value was not found, and the method returns - (low + 1). Otherwise, it returns `ndx`, which is the index of the last occurrence of the target value.
codeFunctions: public int findLast (int low,int high) { int ndx = - 1;while (low <= high) { int mid = (low + high) >>> 1;int delta = compare (mid);if (delta > 0) { high = mid - 1;} else { if (delta == 0) { ndx = mid;} low = mid + 1;} } if (ndx == - 1) { return - (low + 1);} return ndx;}

originalComment: Check if propagation of a transaction is possible due to source and destination transaction modes.
codeComment: This method checks if the existing transaction is valid and if the isolation level of the destination transaction is compatible with the existing transaction. It also checks if the destination transaction is not read-only if the existing transaction is read-only. If any of these conditions are not met, it throws a JtxException.
codeFunctions: protected void continueTx (final JtxTransaction sourceTx,final JtxTransactionMode destMode) { if (!validateExistingTransaction) { return;} JtxTransactionMode sourceMode = sourceTx.getTransactionMode ();JtxIsolationLevel destIsolationLevel = destMode.getIsolationLevel ();if (destIsolationLevel != ISOLATION_DEFAULT) { JtxIsolationLevel currentIsolationLevel = sourceMode.getIsolationLevel ();if (currentIsolationLevel != destIsolationLevel) { throw new JtxException ("Participating TX specifies isolation level: " + destIsolationLevel + " which is incompatible with existing TX: " + currentIsolationLevel);} } if ((!destMode.isReadOnly ()) && (sourceMode.isReadOnly ())) { throw new JtxException ("Participating TX is not marked as read-only, but existing TX is");} }

originalComment: Puts the text to the left and pads with spaces until the size is reached.

originalComment: Converts object into pretty string.All arrays are iterated.
codeComment: This method converts an object to a pretty string representation. If the object is null, it returns "null". If the object is an array, it checks the type of the array's component type and converts it to a string using the appropriate method from the ArraysUtil class. If the object is an instance of Iterable, it iterates over the elements and converts each element to a string using the toPrettyString method. If the object is neither an array nor an Iterable, it simply returns the object's toString representation.
codeFunctions: public static String toPrettyString (final Object value) { if (value == null) { return StringPool.NULL;} final Class <?> type = value.getClass ();if (type.isArray ()) { final Class componentType = type.getComponentType ();if (componentType.isPrimitive ()) { final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder ();sb.append (' ');if (componentType == int.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((int [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == long.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((long [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == double.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((double [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == float.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((float [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == boolean.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((boolean [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == short.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((short [ ]) value));} else if (componentType == byte.class) { sb.append (ArraysUtil.toString ((byte [ ]) value));} else { throw new IllegalArgumentException ();} sb.append (' ');return sb.toString ();} else { final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder ();sb.append (' ');final Object [ ] array = (Object [ ]) value;for (int i = 0;i < array.length;i ++) { if (i > 0) { sb.append (' ');} sb.append (toPrettyString (array [ i ]));} sb.append (' ');return sb.toString ();} } else if (value instanceof Iterable) { final Iterable iterable = (Iterable) value;final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder ();sb.append (' ');int i = 0;for (final Object o:iterable) { if (i > 0) { sb.append (' ');} sb.append (toPrettyString (o));i ++;} sb.append (' ');return sb.toString ();} return value.toString ();}

originalComment: Converts separated string value to CamelCase.

If the flag is set, it converts the character to uppercase and appends it to the result string. Otherwise, it appends the character as is. Finally, it returns the resulting camel case string.
codeFunctions: public static String toCamelCase (final String input,final boolean firstCharUppercase,final char separator) { final int length = input.length ();final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder (length);boolean upperCase = firstCharUppercase;for (int i = 0;i < length;i ++) { final char ch = input.charAt (i);if (ch == separator) { upperCase = true;} else if (upperCase) { sb.append (Character.toUpperCase (ch));upperCase = false;} else { sb.append (ch);} } return sb.toString ();}

originalComment: Formats provided string as paragraph.

codeFunctions: public static String formatParagraph (final String src,final int len,final boolean breakOnWhitespace) { StringBuilder str = new StringBuilder ();int total = src.length ();int from = 0;while (from < total) { int to = from + len;if (to >= total) { to = total;} else if (breakOnWhitespace) { int ndx = StringUtil.lastIndexOfWhitespace (src,to - 1,from);if (ndx != - 1) { to = ndx + 1;} } int cutFrom = StringUtil.indexOfNonWhitespace (src,from,to);if (cutFrom != - 1) { int cutTo = StringUtil.lastIndexOfNonWhitespace (src,to - 1,from) + 1;str.append (src,cutFrom,cutTo);} str.append (' ');from = to;} return str.toString ();}

It iterates through the string, finding spaces and calculating the number of spaces needed to align them to the next tab stop. It then appends the necessary spaces to the result and continues until all spaces have been converted. If the tab width is zero, it simply removes all spaces from the string.
codeFunctions: public static String convertTabsToSpaces (final String line,final int tabWidth) { int tab_index,tab_size;int last_tab_index = 0;int added_chars = 0;if (tabWidth == 0) { return StringUtil.remove (line,' ');} StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder ();while ((tab_index = line.indexOf (' ',last_tab_index)) != - 1) { tab_size = tabWidth - ((tab_index + added_chars) % tabWidth);if (tab_size == 0) { tab_size = tabWidth;} added_chars += tab_size - 1;result.append (line,last_tab_index,tab_index);result.append (StringUtil.repeat (' ',tab_size));last_tab_index = tab_index + 1;} if (last_tab_index == 0) { return line;} result.append (line.substring (last_tab_index));return result.toString ();}

originalComment: Escapes a string using java rules.
codeComment: This method takes a string and escapes special characters in Java syntax. It replaces spaces with their respective escape sequences (e.g., \b for backspace, \t for tab, \n for newline, etc.), and non-printable characters (ASCII values less than 32 or greater than 127) with their Unicode escape sequences (e.g., \u0001 for ASCII 1).
codeFunctions: public static String escapeJava (final String string) { int strLen = string.length ();StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder (strLen);for (int i = 0;i < strLen;i ++) { char c = string.charAt (i);switch (c) { case ' ':sb.append ("\\b");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\t");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\n");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\f");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\r");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\\"");break;case ' ':sb.append ("\\\\");break;default:if ((c < 32) || (c > 127)) { String hex = Integer.toHexString (c);sb.append ("\\u");for (int k = hex.length ();k < 4;k ++) { sb.append (' ');} sb.append (hex);} else { sb.append (c);} } } return sb.toString ();}

originalComment: Unescapes a string using java rules.
codeComment: This method unescapes Java escape sequences in a given string. It iterates over each character in the input string, checks if it is a space, and if so, skips the next character. If the next character is a backslash, it checks if the next character is a space and appends a space to the result. If the next character is a backslash followed by a hexadecimal digit, it parses the hexadecimal digits and appends the corresponding character to the result. If the next character is not a space or a backslash followed by a hexadecimal digit, it throws an IllegalArgumentException.
codeFunctions: public static String unescapeJava (final String str) { char [ ] chars = str.toCharArray ();StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder (str.length ());for (int i = 0;i < chars.length;i ++) { char c = chars [ i ];if (c != ' ') { sb.append (c);continue;} i ++;c = chars [ i ];switch (c) { case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':sb.append (' ');break;case ' ':char hex = (char) Integer.parseInt (new String (chars,i + 1,4),16);sb.append (hex);i += 4;break;default:throw new IllegalArgumentException ("Invalid escaping character: " + c);} } return sb.toString ();}

originalComment: Returns Petite bean instance.Bean name will be resolved from provided type.
codeComment: This method retrieves a bean of a specified type from the application context. It first resolves the bean name using the `resolveBeanName` method and then retrieves the bean using the resolved name. The method is generic and can return any type of bean.
codeFunctions: @ SuppressWarnings ({ "unchecked" }) public < T > T getBean (final Class < T > type) { String name = resolveBeanName (type);return (T) getBean (name);}

originalComment: Returns Petite bean instance.Petite container will find the bean in corresponding scope and all its dependencies either by constructor or property injection.When using constructor injection cyclic dependencies can not be prevented but at least they are detected.
codeComment: This method retrieves a bean from a container. It first checks if a bean definition exists for the given name. If not, it looks for a provider definition. If a provider is found, it invokes the provider to get the bean. If no bean is found, it creates a new bean in the specified scope, initializes it, registers it, wires it, injects parameters, and invokes initialization methods. The method returns the bean as the specified type.
codeFunctions: public < T > T getBean (final String name) { // Lookup for registered bean definition. BeanDefinition def = lookupBeanDefinition (name);if (def == null) { // try provider ProviderDefinition providerDefinition = providers.get (name);if (providerDefinition != null) { return (T) invokeProvider (providerDefinition);} return null;} // Find the bean in its scope Object bean = def.scopeLookup ();if (bean == null) { // Create new bean in the scope initBeanDefinition (def);final BeanData beanData = new BeanData (this,def);registerBeanAndWireAndInjectParamsAndInvokeInitMethods (beanData);bean = beanData.bean ();} return (T) bean;}

originalComment: Resolves and initializes bean definition.May be called multiple times.
codeComment: This method initializes various components of a bean definition, including initialization methods, destruction methods, properties, methods, constructors, values, sets, and parameters. It uses the `petiteResolvers` to resolve these components based on the type of the bean and the wiring mode.
codeFunctions: protected void initBeanDefinition (final BeanDefinition def) { // init methods if (def.initMethods == null) { def.initMethods = petiteResolvers.resolveInitMethodPoint (def.type);} // destroy methods if (def.destroyMethods == null) { def.destroyMethods = petiteResolvers.resolveDestroyMethodPoint (def.type);} // properties if (def.properties == null) { def.properties = petiteResolvers.resolvePropertyInjectionPoint (def.type,def.wiringMode == WiringMode.AUTOWIRE);} // methods if (def.methods == null) { def.methods = petiteResolvers.resolveMethodInjectionPoint (def.type);} // ctors if (def.ctor == null) { def.ctor = petiteResolvers.resolveCtorInjectionPoint (def.type);} // values if (def.values == null) { def.values = paramManager.resolveParamInjectionPoints (def.type);} // sets if (def.sets == null) { def.sets = petiteResolvers.resolveSetInjectionPoint (def.type,def.wiringMode == WiringMode.AUTOWIRE);} // params if (def.params == null) { def.params = paramManager.filterParametersForBeanName (def.name,petiteConfig.getResolveReferenceParameters ());} }

originalComment: Invokes provider to get a bean.
codeComment: The method `invokeProvider` takes a `ProviderDefinition` object as input and attempts to invoke a method on a bean. If the provider has a method defined, it checks if the bean name is provided. If the bean name is present, it retrieves the bean using the `getBean` method. If the bean name is not provided, it sets the bean to `null`. The method then attempts to invoke the method on the bean using reflection. If an exception occurs during the invocation, it throws a `PetiteException` with an appropriate error message. If the provider does not have a method defined, it throws a `PetiteException` with a different error message.
codeFunctions: protected Object invokeProvider (final ProviderDefinition provider) { if (provider.method != null) { final Object bean;if (provider.beanName != null) { // instance factory method bean = getBean (provider.beanName);} else { // static factory method bean = null;} try { return provider.method.invoke (bean);} catch (Exception ex) { throw new PetiteException ("Invalid provider method: " + provider.method.getName (),ex);} } throw new PetiteException ("Invalid provider");}

originalComment: Adds object instance to the container as singleton bean.
codeComment: This method adds a bean to the Petite container with the specified name, bean object, and wiring mode. It first resolves the wiring mode using the Petite configuration, then registers the bean with the Petite container, and finally looks up the existing bean definition and registers the bean, wires it, injects parameters, and invokes initialization methods.
codeFunctions: public void addBean (final String name,final Object bean,WiringMode wiringMode) { wiringMode = petiteConfig.resolveWiringMode (wiringMode);registerPetiteBean (bean.getClass (),name,SingletonScope.class,wiringMode,false,null);BeanDefinition def = lookupExistingBeanDefinition (name);registerBeanAndWireAndInjectParamsAndInvokeInitMethods (new BeanData (this,def,bean));}

originalComment: Sets petite bean property.
codeComment: This method sets a property on a bean using the given name and value. It first attempts to find the bean by splitting the name on spaces and iterating backwards until it finds a valid bean name. If no valid bean name is found, it throws a PetiteException. If a valid bean is found, it attempts to set the property using the BeanUtil.declared.setProperty method. If an exception occurs during the property setting, it throws a PetiteException.
codeFunctions: public void setBeanProperty (final String name,final Object value) { Object bean = null;int ndx = name.length ();while (true) { ndx = name.lastIndexOf (' ',ndx);if (ndx == - 1) { break;} String beanName = name.substring (0,ndx);bean = getBean (beanName);if (bean != null) { break;} ndx --;} if (bean == null) { throw new PetiteException ("Invalid bean property: " + name);} try { BeanUtil.declared.setProperty (bean,name.substring (ndx + 1),value);} catch (Exception ex) { throw new PetiteException ("Invalid bean property: " + name,ex);} }

originalComment: Returns petite bean property value.
codeComment: This method retrieves a property from a bean using its name. It first checks if the input string contains a space, indicating that a property name is specified. If not, it throws a PetiteException. It then extracts the bean name and retrieves the bean using the `getBean` method. If the bean is null, it throws a PetiteException. Finally, it attempts to retrieve the property using `BeanUtil.declared.getProperty` and throws a PetiteException if an exception occurs.
codeFunctions: public Object getBeanProperty (final String name) { int ndx = name.indexOf (' ');if (ndx == - 1) { throw new PetiteException ("Only bean name is specified, missing property name: " + name);} String beanName = name.substring (0,ndx);Object bean = getBean (beanName);if (bean == null) { throw new PetiteException ("Bean doesn't exist: " + name);} try { return BeanUtil.declared.getProperty (bean,name.substring (ndx + 1));} catch (Exception ex) { throw new PetiteException ("Invalid bean property: " + name,ex);} }

originalComment: Shutdowns container.After container is down it can t be used anymore.
codeComment:
The `shutdown` method performs several cleanup operations:
1. Iterates over each value in the `scopes` map and calls the `shutdown` method on each `Scope` object.
2. Clears the `externalsCache`, `beans`, `beansAlt`, `scopes`, `providers`, and `beanCollections` maps.

originalComment: Resolves method parameters from a method or constructor.Returns an empty array when target does not contain any parameter.No caching is involved in this process i.e.class bytecode is examined every time this method is called.
codeComment: This method resolves method or constructor parameters by reading the class bytes from the class loader, parsing the class using a `ClassReader`, and then using a `MethodFinder` visitor to extract the resolved parameters. If the class is not found or an I/O error occurs, it throws a `ParamoException`.
codeFunctions: public static MethodParameter [ ] resolveParameters (final AccessibleObject methodOrCtor) { Class [ ] paramTypes;Class declaringClass;String name;if (methodOrCtor instanceof Method) { Method method = (Method) methodOrCtor;paramTypes = method.getParameterTypes ();name = method.getName ();declaringClass = method.getDeclaringClass ();} else { Constructor constructor = (Constructor) methodOrCtor;paramTypes = constructor.getParameterTypes ();declaringClass = constructor.getDeclaringClass ();name = CTOR_METHOD;} if (paramTypes.length == 0) { return MethodParameter.EMPTY_ARRAY;} InputStream stream;try { stream = ClassLoaderUtil.getClassAsStream (declaringClass);} catch (IOException ioex) { throw new ParamoException ("Failed to read class bytes: " + declaringClass.getName (),ioex);} if (stream == null) { throw new ParamoException ("Class not found: " + declaringClass);} try { ClassReader reader = new ClassReader (stream);MethodFinder visitor = new MethodFinder (declaringClass,name,paramTypes);reader.accept (visitor,0);return visitor.getResolvedParameters ();} catch (IOException ioex) { throw new ParamoException (ioex);} finally { StreamUtil.close (stream);} }

originalComment: Performs smart form population.
codeComment: This method overrides the `doAfterBody` method of a JSP tag handler. It retrieves the body content, gets the enclosing JspWriter, and populates the form with data using the `populateForm` method. The populated form text is then printed to the JspWriter, and any IOExceptions are caught and rethrown as JspExceptions. The method returns SKIP_BODY.
codeFunctions: @ Override public int doAfterBody () throws JspException { BodyContent body = getBodyContent ();JspWriter out = body.getEnclosingWriter ();String bodytext = populateForm (body.getString (),name -> value (name,pageContext));try { out.print (bodytext);} catch (IOException ioex) { throw new JspException (ioex);} return SKIP_BODY;}

originalComment: Returns the property value with replaced macros.

If `hasMacro` is false, it simply returns the `value` without any modifications.

originalComment: Finishes the tree building.Closes unclosed tags.
codeComment: This method handles the end of a DOM tree. It checks if the current node is not the root node and iterates through its parent nodes, checking for implied end tags and closing them if necessary. It also removes any whitespace between tags if configured, fixes foster elements if configured, and logs the creation time of the DOM tree.
codeFunctions: @ Override public void end () { if (parentNode != rootNode) { Node thisNode = parentNode;while (thisNode != rootNode) { if (domBuilder.config.isImpliedEndTags ()) { if (implRules.implicitlyCloseTagOnEOF (thisNode.getNodeName ())) { thisNode = thisNode.getParentNode ();continue;} } error ("Unclosed tag closed: <" + thisNode.getNodeName () + ">");thisNode = thisNode.getParentNode ();} } // remove whitespaces if (domBuilder.config.isIgnoreWhitespacesBetweenTags ()) { removeLastChildNodeIfEmptyText (parentNode,true);} // foster if (domBuilder.config.isUseFosterRules ()) { HtmlFosterRules fosterRules = new HtmlFosterRules ();fosterRules.fixFosterElements (rootNode);} // elapsed rootNode.end ();if (log.isDebugEnabled ()) { log.debug ("LagartoDom tree created in " + rootNode.getElapsedTime () + " ms");} }

originalComment: Creates new element with correct configuration.
codeComment: This method creates a new `Element` node based on the provided `Tag`. It checks if the tag is a void tag by comparing its name against a list of void tags defined in `htmlVoidRules`. If the tag is void, it determines if the element should be self-closed based on the configuration of the `domBuilder`. The method returns a new `Element` object with the specified properties.
codeFunctions: protected Element createElementNode (final Tag tag) { boolean hasVoidTags = htmlVoidRules != null;boolean isVoid = false;boolean selfClosed = false;if (hasVoidTags) { isVoid = htmlVoidRules.isVoidTag (tag.getName ());// HTML and XHTML if (isVoid) { // it's void tag, lookup the flag selfClosed = domBuilder.config.isSelfCloseVoidTags ();} } else { // XML, no voids, lookup the flag selfClosed = domBuilder.config.isSelfCloseVoidTags ();} return new Element (rootNode,tag,isVoid,selfClosed);}

originalComment: Visits tags.
codeComment: This method handles the processing of tags in a DOM (Document Object Model) builder. It checks if the builder is enabled and then processes the tag based on its type (START, END, or SELF_CLOSING). For START tags, it creates a new element node and adds it to the parent node, optionally closing any implied parent tags. For END tags, it finds the matching open tag and closes it if implied, or fixes any unclosed tags in between. For SELF_CLOSING tags, it creates a new element node and adds it to the parent node.
codeFunctions: @ Override public void tag (final Tag tag) { if (!enabled) { return;} TagType tagType = tag.getType ();Element node;switch (tagType) { case START:if (domBuilder.config.isIgnoreWhitespacesBetweenTags ()) { removeLastChildNodeIfEmptyText (parentNode,false);} node = createElementNode (tag);if (domBuilder.config.isImpliedEndTags ()) { while (true) { String parentNodeName = parentNode.getNodeName ();if (!implRules.implicitlyCloseParentTagOnNewTag (parentNodeName,node.getNodeName ())) { break;} parentNode = parentNode.getParentNode ();if (log.isDebugEnabled ()) { log.debug ("Implicitly closed tag <" + node.getNodeName () + "> ");} } } parentNode.addChild (node);if (!node.isVoidElement ()) { parentNode = node;} break;case END:if (domBuilder.config.isIgnoreWhitespacesBetweenTags ()) { removeLastChildNodeIfEmptyText (parentNode,true);} String tagName = tag.getName ().toString ();Node matchingParent = findMatchingParentOpenTag (tagName);if (matchingParent == parentNode) { // regular situation parentNode = parentNode.getParentNode ();break;} if (matchingParent == null) { // matching open tag not found, remove it error ("Orphan closed tag ignored: </" + tagName + "> " + tag.getTagPosition ());break;} // try to close it implicitly if (domBuilder.config.isImpliedEndTags ()) { boolean fixed = false;while (implRules.implicitlyCloseParentTagOnTagEnd (parentNode.getNodeName (),tagName)) { parentNode = parentNode.getParentNode ();if (log.isDebugEnabled ()) { log.debug ("Implicitly closed tag <" + tagName + ">");} if (parentNode == matchingParent) { parentNode = matchingParent.parentNode;fixed = true;break;} } if (fixed) { break;} } // matching tag found, but it is not a regular situation // therefore close all unclosed tags in between fixUnclosedTagsUpToMatchingParent (tag,matchingParent);break;case SELF_CLOSING:if (domBuilder.config.isIgnoreWhitespacesBetweenTags ()) { removeLastChildNodeIfEmptyText (parentNode,false);} node = createElementNode (tag);parentNode.addChild (node);break;} }

originalComment: Removes last child node if contains just empty text.
codeComment: This method removes the last child node from a parent node if it is a text node and is blank. If the parent node is null, it returns immediately. If the parent node has no children, it returns immediately. If the last child node is not a text node, it returns immediately. If the parent node has only one child and the closedTag parameter is true, it returns immediately. If the last child node is blank, it detaches the text node from its parent.
codeFunctions: protected void removeLastChildNodeIfEmptyText (final Node parentNode,final boolean closedTag) { if (parentNode == null) { return;} Node lastChild = parentNode.getLastChild ();if (lastChild == null) { return;} if (lastChild.getNodeType () != Node.NodeType.TEXT) { return;} if (closedTag) { if (parentNode.getChildNodesCount () == 1) { return;} } Text text = (Text) lastChild;if (text.isBlank ()) { lastChild.detachFromParent ();} }

originalComment: Returns the query string.
codeComment: This method generates a query string by replacing placeholders in the `sqlTemplate` with values from the `parameterValues` list. If `sqlTemplate` is null, it returns the string representation of the object. If `parameterValues` is null, it returns the `sqlTemplate` as is. The method uses a `StringBuilder` to construct the query string and a `StringTokenizer` to split the `sqlTemplate` by question marks. It iterates over each chunk, appending it to the `StringBuilder`. If a value is found in the `parameterValues` list, it is appended to the `StringBuilder`; otherwise, a question mark is appended. If an exception occurs during the process, it appends an error message to the `StringBuilder`. Finally, it returns the constructed query string after trimming any leading or trailing whitespace.
codeFunctions: public String getQueryString () { if (sqlTemplate == null) { return toString ();} if (parameterValues == null) { return sqlTemplate;} final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder ();int qMarkCount = 0;final StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer (sqlTemplate + ' ',"?");while (tok.hasMoreTokens ()) { final String oneChunk = tok.nextToken ();sb.append (oneChunk);try { Object value = null;if (parameterValues.size () > 1 + qMarkCount) { value = parameterValues.get (1 + qMarkCount);qMarkCount ++;} else { if (!tok.hasMoreTokens ()) { value = "";} } if (value == null) { value = "?";} sb.append (value);} catch (Throwable th) { sb.append ("--- Building query failed: ").append (th.toString ());} } return sb.toString ().trim ();}

originalComment: Returns correct action class name.Detects Proxetta classes.
