originalComment: This is an amazing little recursive method.It walks a fanout of nested collection to pull out the leaf nodes
codeComment: This method recursively retrieves a nested property from a collection or array. It takes an object `o`, a property name `propName`, an index `index`, and an array `path` as input. The method first attempts to retrieve the field values from the collection or array using the `_getFieldValuesFromCollectionOrArray` method. If the index plus one equals the length of the path, it returns the current object. Otherwise, it increments the index and calls itself recursively with the updated index and path.
codeFunctions: private static Object getCollectionProp (Object o,String propName,int index,String [ ] path) { o = _getFieldValuesFromCollectionOrArray (o,propName);if (index + 1 == path.length) { return o;} else { index ++;return getCollectionProp (o,path [ index ],index,path);} }

originalComment: This is one is forgiving of null paths.This works with getters first i.e.properties.
codeComment: This method retrieves a property value from an object using reflection. It first checks if the object is null and returns null if it is. If the property is a digit, it attempts to index the object using the digit as an index. It then retrieves the class of the object and attempts to find a getter method for the property using reflection. If no getter method is found, it attempts to find all accessible fields in the class. If the property is not found in either the getter methods or the fields, it returns null. Otherwise, it returns the value of the property using the getter method or the field.
codeFunctions: public static Object getProp (Object object,final String property) { if (object == null) { return null;} if (isDigits (property)) { /* We can index numbers and names. */ object = idx (object,StringScanner.parseInt (property));} Class <?> cls = object.getClass ();/** Tries the getters first. */ Map < String,FieldAccess > fields = Reflection.getPropertyFieldAccessors (cls);if (!fields.containsKey (property)) { fields = Reflection.getAllAccessorFields (cls);} if (!fields.containsKey (property)) { return null;} else { return fields.get (property).getValue (object);} }

originalComment: Get an int property.
codeComment: This method retrieves an integer property from a nested object structure. It first checks if the last property is a digit, in which case it directly converts the property value to an integer. If the last property is not a digit, it retrieves the object based on the properties, retrieves the fields of the object, and then retrieves the integer value of the last property.
codeFunctions: public static int getPropertyInt (final Object root,final String ... properties) { final String lastProperty = properties [ properties.length - 1 ];if (isDigits (lastProperty)) { return Conversions.toInt (getPropertyValue (root,properties));} Object object = baseForGetProperty (root,properties);Map < String,FieldAccess > fields = getFieldsFromObject (object);FieldAccess field = fields.get (lastProperty);if (field.type () == Typ.intgr) { return field.getInt (object);} else { return Conversions.toInt (field.getValue (object));} }

public void init () { /* If the parent and name are equal to null,

originalComment: This actually sends the request.
codeComment: This method sends an HTTP request using the provided `HttpClient` and handles the response using the `responseHandler`. If the request method is not "GET", it sets the "Content-Type" header to "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" and sends the request body. If the request method is "GET", it simply sends the request without a body. If the `closed` flag is set, it schedules a task to connect again after 10 milliseconds. If the connection is successful, it runs the `runnable` task. If the connection fails after 10 retries, it handles the response with a timeout error. If the connection is successful after the retries, it runs the `runnable` task.
codeFunctions: private void sendHttpRequest (final Request request,final org.boon.core.Handler < Response > responseHandler) { final HttpClientRequest httpClientRequest = httpClient.request (request.getMethod (),request.uri (),handleResponse (request,responseHandler));final Runnable runnable = new Runnable () { @ Override public void run () { if (!request.getMethod ().equals ("GET")) { httpClientRequest.putHeader ("Content-Type","application/x-www-form-urlencoded").end (request.paramBody ());} else { httpClientRequest.end ();} } };if (closed.get ()) { this.scheduledExecutorService.schedule (new Runnable () { @ Override public void run () { connect ();int retry = 0;while (closed.get ()) { Sys.sleep (1000);if (!closed.get ()) { break;} retry ++;if (retry > 10) { break;} if (retry % 3 == 0) { connect ();} } if (!closed.get ()) { runnable.run ();} else { responseHandler.handle (new Response ("TIMEOUT",- 1,new Error (- 1,"Timeout","Timeout",- 1L)));} } },10,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);} else { runnable.run ();} }

codeComment: This method creates a database if it does not already exist. It first checks if the database name is not empty. It then attempts to retrieve the database using a GET request. If the database does not exist, it creates the database by sending a PUT request. Finally, it logs the creation of the database and closes any open responses.
codeFunctions: public void createDB (String dbName) { assertNotEmpty (dbName,"dbName");InputStream getresp = null;HttpResponse putresp = null;final URI uri = buildUri (dbc.getBaseUri ()).path (dbName).build ();try { getresp = dbc.get (uri);} catch (NoDocumentException e) { // db doesn't exist final HttpPut put = new HttpPut (uri);putresp = dbc.executeRequest (put);log.info (String.format ("Created Database: '%s'",dbName));} finally { close (getresp);close (putresp);} }

originalComment: List directory contents for a resource folder.Not recursive.This is basically a brute - force implementation.Works for regular files and also JARs.
codeComment: This method lists resources from a specified path. It first checks if the path is a file or a JAR file. If it's a file, it lists the files in the directory. If it's a JAR file, it extracts the resources from the JAR file and returns them as a list of strings. If an exception occurs, it throws a CouchDbException.
codeFunctions: public static List < String > listResources (String path) { try { Class < CouchDbUtil > clazz = CouchDbUtil.class;URL dirURL = clazz.getClassLoader ().getResource (path);if (dirURL != null && dirURL.getProtocol ().equals ("file")) { return Arrays.asList (new File (dirURL.toURI ()).list ());} if (dirURL != null && dirURL.getProtocol ().equals ("jar")) { String jarPath = dirURL.getPath ().substring (5,dirURL.getPath ().indexOf ("!"));JarFile jar = new JarFile (URLDecoder.decode (jarPath,"UTF-8"));Enumeration < JarEntry > entries = jar.entries ();Set < String > result = new HashSet < String > ();while (entries.hasMoreElements ()) { String name = entries.nextElement ().getName ();if (name.startsWith (SPRING_BOOT_DIR)) { name = name.substring (SPRING_BOOT_DIR.length ());} if (name.startsWith (path)) { String entry = name.substring (path.length ());int checkSubdir = entry.indexOf ("/");if (checkSubdir >= 0) { entry = entry.substring (0,checkSubdir);} if (entry.length () > 0) { result.add (entry);} } } close (jar);return new ArrayList < String > (result);} return null;} catch (Exception e) { throw new CouchDbException (e);} }

originalComment: Triggers a replication request.
codeComment: This method triggers a replication process by sending a POST request to a specified URI with a JSON payload. It first checks if the source and target are not empty, then creates a JSON object, logs it if debug is enabled, builds a URI, sends a POST request, reads the response stream, and parses the JSON response into a `ReplicationResult` object. Finally, it closes the response.
codeFunctions: public ReplicationResult trigger () { assertNotEmpty (source,"Source");assertNotEmpty (target,"Target");HttpResponse response = null;try { JsonObject json = createJson ();if (log.isDebugEnabled ()) { log.debug (json);} final URI uri = buildUri (dbc.getBaseUri ()).path ("_replicate").build ();response = dbc.post (uri,json.toString ());final InputStreamReader reader = new InputStreamReader (getStream (response),Charsets.UTF_8);return dbc.getGson ().fromJson (reader,ReplicationResult.class);} finally { close (response);} }

codeFunctions: private < V > V queryValue (Class < V > classOfV) { InputStream instream = null;try { Reader reader = new InputStreamReader (instream = queryForStream (),Charsets.UTF_8);JsonArray array = new JsonParser ().parse (reader).getAsJsonObject ().get ("rows").getAsJsonArray ();if (array.size () != 1) { throw new NoDocumentException ("Expecting a single result but was: " + array.size ());} return JsonToObject (gson,array.get (0),"value",classOfV);} finally { close (instream);} }

originalComment: Gets a design document from desk.
codeComment: This method retrieves a `DesignDocument` from a specified directory based on the given ID. It first checks if the ID is not empty and then constructs the path to the design document directory. It retrieves all resources from the directory and checks if the "views" subdirectory exists. If it does, it reads the map and reduce functions for each view and stores them in a `MapReduce` object. The method then populates various fields of the `DesignDocument` object such as ID, language, views, filters, shows, lists, updates, validation, rewrites, fulltext, and indexes. Finally, it returns the populated `DesignDocument` object.
codeFunctions: public DesignDocument getFromDesk (String id) { assertNotEmpty (id,"id");final DesignDocument dd = new DesignDocument ();final String rootPath = format ("%s/%s/",DESIGN_DOCS_DIR,id);final List < String > elements = listResources (rootPath);if (elements == null) { throw new IllegalArgumentException ("Design docs directory cannot be empty.");} // Views Map < String,MapReduce > views = null;if (elements.contains (VIEWS)) { views = new HashMap < String,MapReduce > ();final String viewsPath = format ("%s%s/",rootPath,VIEWS);for (String viewDirName:listResources (viewsPath)) { // views sub-dirs final MapReduce mr = new MapReduce ();final String viewPath = format ("%s%s/",viewsPath,viewDirName);final List < String > dirList = listResources (viewPath);for (String fileName:dirList) { // view files final String def = readFile (format ("/%s%s",viewPath,fileName));if (MAP_JS.equals (fileName)) mr.setMap (def);else if (REDUCE_JS.equals (fileName)) mr.setReduce (def);} // /foreach view files views.put (viewDirName,mr);} // /foreach views sub-dirs } // /views dd.setId (DESIGN_PREFIX + id);dd.setLanguage (JAVASCRIPT);dd.setViews (views);dd.setFilters (populateMap (rootPath,elements,FILTERS));dd.setShows (populateMap (rootPath,elements,SHOWS));dd.setLists (populateMap (rootPath,elements,LISTS));dd.setUpdates (populateMap (rootPath,elements,UPDATES));dd.setValidateDocUpdate (readContent (elements,rootPath,VALIDATE_DOC));dd.setRewrites (dbc.getGson ().fromJson (readContent (elements,rootPath,REWRITES),JsonArray.class));dd.setFulltext (dbc.getGson ().fromJson (readContent (elements,rootPath,FULLTEXT),JsonObject.class));dd.setIndexes (dbc.getGson ().fromJson (readContent (elements,rootPath,INDEXES),JsonObject.class));return dd;}

codeComment: This method handles a failure in an HTTP request. It logs the error, closes the connection, and checks if the request can be retried. If retries are allowed and the maximum number of retries has not been reached, it creates a waiter and attempts to offer it to the connection pool. If the offer fails, it ends the exchange with an INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR and TOO_MANY_PENDING_REQUESTS status. If retries are not allowed, it ends the exchange with an INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR and CLIENT_REQUEST_FAILURE status.
codeFunctions: private void onRequestFailure (HttpServerExchange serverExchange,PooledConnection connection,IOException e,boolean retry) { log.debug ("Client request failure",e);IoUtils.safeClose (connection);ConnectionPool connectionPool = connectionPools.get (serverExchange.getIoThread ());connectionPool.release (connection);AuthContext context = serverExchange.getAttachment (AUTH_CONTEXT_KEY);if (context.retries < MAX_RETRY && retry) { context.retries ++;PooledConnectionWaiter waiter = createWaiter (serverExchange);if (!connectionPool.offer (waiter)) { endExchange (serverExchange,INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,TOO_MANY_PENDING_REQUESTS);} } else { endExchange (serverExchange,INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,CLIENT_REQUEST_FAILURE);} }

codeComment: This method creates a Buckets object based on a given start, end, and step value. It first checks if the time range is valid and if the step is positive. If the step is greater than the range, it returns a Buckets object with a single bucket. Otherwise, it calculates the number of buckets by dividing the range by the step and adjusting for any remainder. It then checks if the computed number of buckets is within the maximum integer value and returns a Buckets object with the calculated number of buckets.
codeFunctions: public static Buckets fromStep (long start,long end,long step) { checkTimeRange (start,end);checkArgument (step > 0,"step is not positive: %s",step);if (step > (end - start)) { return new Buckets (start,step,1);} long quotient = (end - start) / step;long remainder = (end - start) % step;long count;if (remainder == 0) { count = quotient;} else { count = quotient + 1;} checkArgument (count <= Integer.MAX_VALUE,"Computed number of buckets is too big: %s",count);return new Buckets (start,step,(int) count);}

codeComment: This method calculates the average of the closest point error between a model polygon and a target polygon. It does this by randomly selecting points on the target polygon and finding the closest point on the model polygon to each of these points. The error is the distance between the closest point on the model and the point on the target. The method returns the average of these errors over a specified number of samples.
codeFunctions: public static double averageOfClosestPointError (Polygon2D_F64 model,Polygon2D_F64 target,int numberOfSamples) { LineSegment2D_F64 line = new LineSegment2D_F64 ();double cornerLocationsB [ ] = new double [ target.size () + 1 ];double totalLength = 0;for (int i = 0;i < target.size ();i ++) { Point2D_F64 b0 = target.get (i % target.size ());Point2D_F64 b1 = target.get ((i + 1) % target.size ());cornerLocationsB [ i ] = totalLength;totalLength += b0.distance (b1);} cornerLocationsB [ target.size () ] = totalLength;Point2D_F64 pointOnB = new Point2D_F64 ();double error = 0;int cornerB = 0;for (int k = 0;k < numberOfSamples;k ++) { // Find the point on B to match to a point on A double location = totalLength * k / numberOfSamples;while (location > cornerLocationsB [ cornerB + 1 ]) { cornerB ++;} Point2D_F64 b0 = target.get (cornerB);Point2D_F64 b1 = target.get ((cornerB + 1) % target.size ());double locationCornerB = cornerLocationsB [ cornerB ];double fraction = (location - locationCornerB) / (cornerLocationsB [ cornerB + 1 ] - locationCornerB);pointOnB.x = (b1.x - b0.x) * fraction + b0.x;pointOnB.y = (b1.y - b0.y) * fraction + b0.y;// find the best fit point on A to the point in B double best = Double.MAX_VALUE;for (int i = 0;i < model.size () + 1;i ++) { line.a = model.get (i % model.size ());line.b = model.get ((i + 1) % model.size ());double d = Distance2D_F64.distance (line,pointOnB);if (d < best) { best = d;} } error += best;} return error / numberOfSamples;}

codeFunctions: public static Quaternion_F64 matrixToQuaternion (DMatrixRMaj R,Quaternion_F64 quat) { if (quat == null) quat = new Quaternion_F64 ();// algorithm from: // http://www.euclideanspace.com/maths/geometry/rotations/conversions/matrixToQuaternion/ // // Designed to minimize numerical error by not dividing by very small numbers double m00 = R.unsafe_get (0,0);double m01 = R.unsafe_get (0,1);double m02 = R.unsafe_get (0,2);double m10 = R.unsafe_get (1,0);double m11 = R.unsafe_get (1,1);double m12 = R.unsafe_get (1,2);double m20 = R.unsafe_get (2,0);double m21 = R.unsafe_get (2,1);double m22 = R.unsafe_get (2,2);double trace = m00 + m11 + m22;if (trace > 0) { double S = Math.sqrt (trace + 1.0) * 2;// S=4*qw quat.w = 0.25 * S;quat.x = (m21 - m12) / S;quat.y = (m02 - m20) / S;quat.z = (m10 - m01) / S;} else if ((m00 > m11) & (m00 > m22)) { double S = Math.sqrt (1.0 + m00 - m11 - m22) * 2;// S=4*qx quat.w = (m21 - m12) / S;quat.x = 0.25 * S;quat.y = (m01 + m10) / S;quat.z = (m02 + m20) / S;} else if (m11 > m22) { double S = Math.sqrt (1.0 + m11 - m00 - m22) * 2;// S=4*qy quat.w = (m02 - m20) / S;quat.x = (m01 + m10) / S;quat.y = 0.25 * S;quat.z = (m12 + m21) / S;} else { double S = Math.sqrt (1.0 + m22 - m00 - m11) * 2;// S=4*qz quat.w = (m10 - m01) / S;quat.x = (m02 + m20) / S;quat.y = (m12 + m21) / S;quat.z = 0.25 * S;} return quat;}

codeFunctions: public static TwistCoordinate_F64 twist (Se3_F64 motion,TwistCoordinate_F64 twist) { if (twist == null) twist = new TwistCoordinate_F64 ();if (MatrixFeatures_DDRM.isIdentity (motion.R,GrlConstants.TEST_F64)) { twist.w.set (0,0,0);twist.v.set (motion.T);} else { Rodrigues_F64 rod = new Rodrigues_F64 ();ConvertRotation3D_F64.matrixToRodrigues (motion.R,rod);twist.w.set (rod.unitAxisRotation);double theta = rod.theta;// A = (I-SO)*hat(w) + w*w'*theta DMatrixRMaj A = CommonOps_DDRM.identity (3);CommonOps_DDRM.subtract (A,motion.R,A);DMatrixRMaj w_hat = GeometryMath_F64.crossMatrix (twist.w,null);DMatrixRMaj tmp = A.copy ();CommonOps_DDRM.mult (tmp,w_hat,A);Vector3D_F64 w = twist.w;A.data [ 0 ] += w.x * w.x * theta;A.data [ 1 ] += w.x * w.y * theta;A.data [ 2 ] += w.x * w.z * theta;A.data [ 3 ] += w.y * w.x * theta;A.data [ 4 ] += w.y * w.y * theta;A.data [ 5 ] += w.y * w.z * theta;A.data [ 6 ] += w.z * w.x * theta;A.data [ 7 ] += w.z * w.y * theta;A.data [ 8 ] += w.z * w.z * theta;DMatrixRMaj y = new DMatrixRMaj (3,1);y.data [ 0 ] = motion.T.x;y.data [ 1 ] = motion.T.y;y.data [ 2 ] = motion.T.z;DMatrixRMaj x = new DMatrixRMaj (3,1);CommonOps_DDRM.solve (A,y,x);twist.w.scale (rod.theta);twist.v.x = (double) x.data [ 0 ];twist.v.y = (double) x.data [ 1 ];twist.v.z = (double) x.data [ 2 ];twist.v.scale (rod.theta);} return twist;}

codeFunctions: public boolean solvePoint (List < Point3D_F64 > points,Point3D_F64 pointOnPlane,Vector3D_F64 outputNormal) { final int N = points.size ();// construct the matrix A.reshape (N,3);int index = 0;for (int i = 0;i < N;i ++) { Point3D_F64 p = points.get (i);A.data [ index ++ ] = p.x - pointOnPlane.x;A.data [ index ++ ] = p.y - pointOnPlane.y;A.data [ index ++ ] = p.z - pointOnPlane.z;} // decompose and find the singular value if (!solverNull.process (A,1,nullspace)) return false;// the normal is the singular vector outputNormal.x = (double) nullspace.unsafe_get (0,0);outputNormal.y = (double) nullspace.unsafe_get (1,0);outputNormal.z = (double) nullspace.unsafe_get (2,0);return true;}

codeFunctions: public static DMatrix3x3 convert (ConicGeneral_F64 src,DMatrix3x3 dst) { if (dst == null) dst = new DMatrix3x3 ();double B = src.B / 2.0;double D = src.D / 2.0;double E = src.E / 2.0;dst.a11 = src.A;dst.a12 = B;dst.a13 = D;dst.a21 = B;dst.a22 = src.C;dst.a23 = E;dst.a31 = D;dst.a32 = E;dst.a33 = src.F;return dst;}

originalComment: Converts the conic into a parabola.If the conic isn t a parabola then it is converted into one by adjusting the value of B.
codeComment: This method converts a `ConicGeneral_F64` object to a `ParabolaGeneral_F64` object. It handles negative values of `A` and `C` by taking the sign of the original value and the square root of the absolute value. The method returns the converted `ParabolaGeneral_F64` object.
codeFunctions: public static ParabolaGeneral_F64 convert (ConicGeneral_F64 src,ParabolaGeneral_F64 dst) { if (dst == null) dst = new ParabolaGeneral_F64 ();// NOTE haven't put much through if this is the correct way to handle negative values of A or C dst.A = Math.signum (src.A) * Math.sqrt (Math.abs (src.A));dst.C = Math.signum (src.C) * Math.sqrt (Math.abs (src.C));dst.D = src.D;dst.E = src.E;dst.F = src.F;return dst;}

originalComment: Converts the parabola into a conic.
codeComment: This method converts a ParabolaGeneral_F64 object to a ConicGeneral_F64 object by squaring the coefficients A and C, doubling the coefficient B, and leaving the other coefficients unchanged.
codeFunctions: public static ConicGeneral_F64 convert (ParabolaGeneral_F64 src,ConicGeneral_F64 dst) { if (dst == null) dst = new ConicGeneral_F64 ();dst.A = src.A * src.A;dst.B = src.A * src.C * 2.0;dst.C = src.C * src.C;dst.D = src.D;dst.E = src.E;dst.F = src.F;return dst;}

originalComment: Assign the Rodrigues coordinates using a 3 element vector.Theta is the vector s magnitude and the axis of rotation is the unit vector.
codeComment: This method sets the `paramVector` by normalizing it and calculating the angle of rotation. It first calculates the absolute values of the components of the vector, then finds the maximum absolute value. If the maximum is zero, it sets the rotation angle to zero and the unit axis rotation to (1,0,0). Otherwise, it normalizes the vector by dividing each component by the maximum absolute value, calculates the angle of rotation using the Pythagorean theorem, and then scales the unit axis rotation by the maximum absolute value.
codeFunctions: public void setParamVector (double x,double y,double z) { double ax = Math.abs (x);double ay = Math.abs (y);double az = Math.abs (z);double max = Math.max (ax,ay);max = Math.max (max,az);if (max == 0) { theta = 0;unitAxisRotation.set (1,0,0);} else { x /= max;y /= max;z /= max;theta = Math.sqrt (x * x + y * y + z * z);unitAxisRotation.x = x / theta;unitAxisRotation.y = y / theta;unitAxisRotation.z = z / theta;theta *= max;} }

originalComment: Angular distance between two half circle angles.
codeComment: The method `distHalf` calculates the distance between two angles `angA` and `angB` in radians. It first computes the absolute difference between the two angles. If this difference is less than or equal to π/2, it returns the difference as is. Otherwise, it returns π minus the difference.
codeFunctions: public static double distHalf (double angA,double angB) { double a = Math.abs (angA - angB);if (a <= Math.PI / 2) return a;else return Math.PI - a;}

originalComment: Finds the line which is the intersection between the two planes.For a valid solution to be returned the planes must not be parallel to each other.If the planes are parallel then the slope of the returned line will have a value of zero for each element.
codeComment: This method calculates the intersection of a plane and a line in 3D space. It first checks if the line's slope is zero, returning false if it is. Then, it finds the closest point on the first plane to the origin. The method calculates the cross product of the normal vectors of the two planes to determine the direction of the intersection line. It then finds the intersection point of the plane and a line passing through the closest point and pointing towards the intersection. Finally, it returns true if the intersection is found, otherwise false.
codeFunctions: public static boolean intersect (PlaneGeneral3D_F64 a,PlaneGeneral3D_F64 b,LineParametric3D_F64 line) { // Line's slope is the cross product of the two normal vectors GeometryMath_F64.cross (a.A,a.B,a.C,b.A,b.B,b.C,line.slope);if (line.slope.normSq () == 0) return false;// Closest point on plane 'a' to origin (0,0,0) double n2 = a.A * a.A + a.B * a.B + a.C * a.C;double closestX = a.A * a.D / n2;double closestY = a.B * a.D / n2;double closestZ = a.C * a.D / n2;// Cross product between normal of 'a' and the line's slope.  This points towards the intersection double slopeX = a.B * line.slope.z - a.C * line.slope.y;double slopeY = a.C * line.slope.x - a.A * line.slope.z;double slopeZ = a.A * line.slope.y - a.B * line.slope.x;// Now find the intersection of the plane and a line containing point 'closest' and pointing towards the // the intersection. double top = b.D - b.A * closestX - b.B * closestY - b.C * closestZ;double bottom = b.A * slopeX + b.B * slopeY + b.C * slopeZ;double d = top / bottom;line.p.x = closestX + d * slopeX;line.p.y = closestY + d * slopeY;line.p.z = closestZ + d * slopeZ;return true;}

originalComment: Determines if the point on the same plane as T is contained inside of T.
codeComment: This method checks if a point `T_v0` is contained within a plane defined by vectors `u`, `v`, and `w0`. It calculates the parametric coordinates `s` and `t` to determine if the point lies within the plane. If either `s` or `t` is outside the valid range, the method returns `false`. Otherwise, it returns `true`.
codeFunctions: private static boolean containedPlane (Point3D_F64 T_v0,Point3D_F64 output,Vector3D_F64 u,Vector3D_F64 v,Vector3D_F64 w0) { double uu,uv,vv,wu,wv,D;uu = u.dot (u);uv = u.dot (v);vv = v.dot (v);w0.minus (output,T_v0);wu = w0.dot (u);wv = w0.dot (v);D = uv * uv - uu * vv;// get and test parametric coords double s,t;s = (uv * wv - vv * wu) / D;if (s < 0.0 || s > 1.0) // I is outside T return false;t = (uv * wu - uu * wv) / D;return!(t < 0.0) &&!((s + t) > 1.0);// I is outside T }

originalComment: Finds the intersection of a line and sphere.There can be 0 1 or 2 intersections.If there is 1 intersection the same point is returned twice.
codeComment: This method checks if a line intersects a sphere. It calculates the coefficients of a quadratic equation derived from the distance between a point on the line and the sphere's center. If the discriminant of this equation is negative, the line does not intersect the sphere, and the method returns false. Otherwise, it calculates the intersection points and sets the line's points accordingly, returning true.
codeFunctions: public static boolean intersect (LineParametric3D_F64 line,Sphere3D_F64 sphere,Point3D_F64 a,Point3D_F64 b) { // this equation was found by solving for l: // ||(P + V*l) - X0|| == r double r2 = sphere.radius * sphere.radius;double PP = GeometryMath_F64.dot (line.p,line.p);double PV = GeometryMath_F64.dot (line.p,line.slope);double PX = GeometryMath_F64.dot (line.p,sphere.center);double VV = GeometryMath_F64.dot (line.slope,line.slope);double VX = GeometryMath_F64.dot (line.slope,sphere.center);double XX = GeometryMath_F64.dot (sphere.center,sphere.center);// Coefficients in the quadratic equation double A = VV;double B = 2.0 * (PV - VX);double C = PP + XX - 2.0 * PX - r2;// solve for the quadratic equation double inner = B * B - 4.0 * A * C;if (inner < 0) return false;double sqrt = Math.sqrt (inner);double t0 = (- B + sqrt) / (2.0 * A);double t1 = (- B - sqrt) / (2.0 * A);line.setPointOnLine (t0,a);line.setPointOnLine (t1,b);return true;}

originalComment: Perform linear interpolation
codeComment: This method interpolates between two 2D poses represented by `Se2_F64` objects, `a` and `b`, at a specified `where` value between 0 and 1. The translation components of the poses are linearly interpolated. The rotation component is interpolated using the `UtilAngle` class to handle the wrap-around of angles.
codeFunctions: public static void interpolate (Se2_F64 a,Se2_F64 b,double where,Se2_F64 output) { double w0 = 1.0 - where;output.T.x = a.T.x * w0 + b.T.x * where;output.T.y = a.T.y * w0 + b.T.y * where;// interpolating rotation is more difficult // This only works well if the difference between the two angles is small double yaw0 = a.getYaw ();double yaw1 = b.getYaw ();double cw = UtilAngle.distanceCW (yaw0,yaw1);double ccw = UtilAngle.distanceCCW (yaw0,yaw1);double yaw;if (cw > ccw) { yaw = yaw0 + ccw * where;} else { yaw = yaw0 - cw * where;} output.setYaw (yaw);}

originalComment: The unit eigenvector corresponding to the maximum eigenvalue of Q is the rotation parameterized as a quaternion.
codeComment: This method extracts a quaternion from a given matrix `q` using eigenvalue decomposition. It finds the maximum eigenvalue and its corresponding eigenvector, which are then used to set the quaternion components. The quaternion is then normalized, and the rotation matrix is converted from the quaternion to the motion's rotation matrix.
codeFunctions: private void extractQuaternionFromQ (SimpleMatrix q) { SimpleEVD < SimpleMatrix > evd = q.eig ();int indexMax = evd.getIndexMax ();SimpleMatrix v_max = evd.getEigenVector (indexMax);quat.w = (double) v_max.get (0);quat.x = (double) v_max.get (1);quat.y = (double) v_max.get (2);quat.z = (double) v_max.get (3);quat.normalize ();ConvertRotation3D_F64.quaternionToMatrix (quat,motion.getR ());}

originalComment: Computes the convex hull.The output will be in counter - clockwise order.
codeComment: This method processes an array of `Point2D_F64` objects to compute the convex hull using the Graham scan algorithm. It handles special cases for arrays of length 2 and sorts the input points. The method constructs the lower and upper hulls by iterating through the sorted points and removing points that do not form a counter-clockwise turn with the last two points in the current hull. The resulting hull is stored in the `hull` parameter.
codeFunctions: public void process (Point2D_F64 [ ] input,int length,Polygon2D_F64 hull) { // ahdnle special cases if (length == 2) { hull.vertexes.resize (length);for (int i = 0;i < length;i ++) { hull.get (i).set (input [ i ]);} return;} sorter.sort (input,length);work.reset ();// construct the lower hull for (int i = 0;i < length;i ++) { Point2D_F64 p = input [ i ];//Contains at least 2 points and the last two points and 'p' do not make a counter-clockwise turn while (work.size () >= 2 && subtractThenCross (p,work.getTail (0),work.getTail (1)) >= 0) { // remove the last points from the hull work.removeTail ();} // append p to the end work.add (p);} work.removeTail ();int minSize = work.size + 2;// construct upper hull for (int i = length - 1;i >= 0;i --) // Finding top layer from hull { //Contains at least 2 points and the last two points and 'p' do not make a counter-clockwise turn Point2D_F64 p = input [ i ];while (work.size () >= minSize && subtractThenCross (p,work.getTail (0),work.getTail (1)) >= 0) { work.removeTail ();} // append p to the end work.add (p);} work.removeTail ();// create a copy for the output // the work buffer contains references to the input points, but to be safe the output should have its // own instances hull.vertexes.resize (work.size);for (int i = 0;i < work.size ();i ++) { hull.vertexes.data [ i ].set (work.get (i));} }

originalComment: Converts it into a 4 by 4 homogeneous matrix.
codeComment: This method converts a `Se3_F64` object to a homogeneous transformation matrix `DMatrixRMaj`. It first checks if the output matrix `ret` is null and initializes it to a 4x4 matrix if necessary. It then sets the last row of `ret` to [0, 0, 0, 1]. The rotation matrix `R` from the `Se3_F64` object is inserted into the upper-left 3x3 submatrix of `ret`. The translation vector `T` from the `Se3_F64` object is then inserted into the last column of `ret`. Finally, the method returns the resulting homogeneous transformation matrix.
codeFunctions: public static DMatrixRMaj toHomogeneous (Se3_F64 se,DMatrixRMaj ret) { if (ret == null) ret = new DMatrixRMaj (4,4);else { ret.set (3,0,0);ret.set (3,1,0);ret.set (3,2,0);} CommonOps_DDRM.insert (se.getR (),ret,0,0);Vector3D_F64 T = se.getT ();ret.set (0,3,T.x);ret.set (1,3,T.y);ret.set (2,3,T.z);ret.set (3,3,1);return ret;}

originalComment: Converts it into a 3 by 3 homogeneous matrix.
codeComment: This method converts a 2D rotation and translation represented by a `Se2_F64` object into a homogeneous transformation matrix. It first checks if the output matrix `ret` is null and initializes it if necessary. Then, it sets the last row of the matrix to `[0, 0, 1]`. The method calculates the cosine and sine of the yaw angle from the `Se2_F64` object and uses them to set the first two rows of the matrix. Finally, it sets the last two columns of the matrix to the x and y coordinates of the translation, respectively. The resulting matrix is returned.
codeFunctions: public static DMatrixRMaj toHomogeneous (Se2_F64 se,DMatrixRMaj ret) { if (ret == null) ret = new DMatrixRMaj (3,3);else { ret.set (2,0,0);ret.set (2,1,0);} final double c = se.getCosineYaw ();final double s = se.getSineYaw ();ret.set (0,0,c);ret.set (0,1,- s);ret.set (1,0,s);ret.set (1,1,c);ret.set (0,2,se.getX ());ret.set (1,2,se.getY ());ret.set (2,2,1);return ret;}

originalComment: Create SE3 using axis - angle for rotation and XYZ tanslation
codeComment: This method constructs a 3D transformation matrix (Se3_F64) from given translation and rotation parameters. It first checks if the input transformation matrix is null and initializes it if necessary. Then, it calculates the rotation angle from the given rotation components. If the rotation angle is zero, it sets the rotation matrix to the identity matrix. Otherwise, it converts the rotation components to a rotation matrix using Rodrigues' formula. Finally, it sets the translation components of the transformation matrix and returns it.
codeFunctions: public static Se3_F64 axisXyz (double dx,double dy,double dz,double rotX,double rotY,double rotZ,Se3_F64 se) { if (se == null) se = new Se3_F64 ();double theta = Math.sqrt (rotX * rotX + rotY + rotY + rotZ * rotZ);if (theta == 0) { CommonOps_DDRM.setIdentity (se.R);} else { ConvertRotation3D_F64.rodriguesToMatrix (rotX / theta,rotY / theta,rotZ / theta,theta,se.getR ());} Vector3D_F64 T = se.getT ();T.x = dx;T.y = dy;T.z = dz;return se;}

originalComment: Can be used to see if two transforms are identical to within tolerance
codeComment: The method `isIdentical` checks if two `Se3_F64` objects, `a` and `b`, are identical within specified tolerances for translation and rotation. It compares the translation components and uses the Rodrigues formula to compute the rotation difference. If the rotation difference is within the specified tolerance, the method returns `true`; otherwise, it returns `false`.
codeFunctions: public static boolean isIdentical (Se3_F64 a,Se3_F64 b,double tolT,double tolR) { if (Math.abs (a.T.x - b.T.x) > tolT) return false;if (Math.abs (a.T.y - b.T.y) > tolT) return false;if (Math.abs (a.T.z - b.T.z) > tolT) return false;DMatrixRMaj D = new DMatrixRMaj (3,3);CommonOps_DDRM.multTransA (a.R,b.R,D);Rodrigues_F64 rod = new Rodrigues_F64 ();ConvertRotation3D_F64.matrixToRodrigues (D,rod);return rod.theta <= tolR;}

originalComment: Converts latitude and longitude coordinates into a unit vector
codeComment: This method converts latitude and longitude coordinates to a unit vector in 3D space. It takes a `GeoTuple3D_F64` object as input and returns a unit vector representing the direction from the Earth's center to the specified latitude and longitude. If the input vector is `null`, it creates a new `Vector3D_F64` object. The method calculates the x, y, and z components of the vector using trigonometric functions based on the latitude and longitude.
codeFunctions: public static < T extends GeoTuple3D_F64 < T > > T latlonToUnitVector (double lat,double lon,T vector) { if (vector == null) vector = (T) new Vector3D_F64 ();vector.x = Math.cos (lat) * Math.cos (lon);vector.y = Math.cos (lat) * Math.sin (lon);vector.z = - Math.sin (lat);return vector;}

originalComment: Given three points find the circle that intersects all three.If false is returned that means the points all lie along a line and there is no circle.
codeComment: This method calculates the center and radius of a circle that passes through three given points (x0, x1, x2) on a line. It first finds the intersection of the lines formed by these points, then calculates the center of the circle using the intersection point and the given points. Finally, it checks if the circle passes through all three points and returns true if it does, otherwise false.
codeFunctions: public static boolean circle (Point2D_F64 x0,Point2D_F64 x1,Point2D_F64 x2,Circle2D_F64 circle) { // points that lie on line a and b double xa = (x0.x + x1.x) / 2.0;double ya = (x0.y + x1.y) / 2.0;double xb = (x1.x + x2.x) / 2.0;double yb = (x1.y + x2.y) / 2.0;// slopes of lines a and b double m2 = x0.x - x1.x;double m1 = x1.y - x0.y;double n2 = x2.x - x1.x;double n1 = x1.y - x2.y;// find the intersection of the lines double bottom = m2 * n1 - n2 * m1;if (bottom == 0) return false;double alpha = (- m2 * (xb - xa) + m1 * (yb - ya)) / bottom;circle.center.x = xb + n1 * alpha;circle.center.y = yb + n2 * alpha;circle.radius = circle.center.distance (x0);return true;}

originalComment: Radius squares of the circle that passes through these three points.
codeComment: This method calculates the square of the radius of the circle that passes through three given points on a line. It first finds the midpoints of the line segments connecting the points. Then, it calculates the slopes of the lines formed by these midpoints. The intersection of these lines is found using the formula for the intersection of two lines. Finally, the square of the distance from the first point to the intersection point is returned as the radius squared.
codeFunctions: public static double circleRadiusSq (Point2D_F64 x0,Point2D_F64 x1,Point2D_F64 x2) { // points that lie on line a and b double xa = (x0.x + x1.x) / 2.0;double ya = (x0.y + x1.y) / 2.0;double xb = (x1.x + x2.x) / 2.0;double yb = (x1.y + x2.y) / 2.0;// slopes of lines a and b double m2 = x0.x - x1.x;double m1 = x1.y - x0.y;double n2 = x2.x - x1.x;double n1 = x1.y - x2.y;// find the intersection of the lines double bottom = m2 * n1 - n2 * m1;if (bottom == 0) return Double.NaN;double alpha = (- m2 * (xb - xa) + m1 * (yb - ya)) / bottom;double dx = xb + n1 * alpha - x0.x;double dy = yb + n2 * alpha - x0.y;return dx * dx + dy * dy;}

originalComment: Returns the point which minimizes the distance between the two lines in 3D.If the two lines are parallel the result is undefined.
codeComment: This method calculates the closest point between two parametric lines in 3D space. It takes two `LineParametric3D_F64` objects and a `Point3D_F64` object as input. The method first checks if the output point is null and initializes it if necessary. It then calculates the vector `ret` between the points of the two lines. Using the dot product, it computes the necessary coefficients to find the intersection point of the two lines. If the denominator is zero, it returns null, indicating that the lines are parallel. Otherwise, it calculates the intersection parameter `t0` and `t1` and uses them to find the closest point on each line. Finally, it returns the closest point as a `Point3D_F64` object.
codeFunctions: public static Point3D_F64 closestPoint (LineParametric3D_F64 l0,LineParametric3D_F64 l1,Point3D_F64 ret) { if (ret == null) { ret = new Point3D_F64 ();} ret.x = l0.p.x - l1.p.x;ret.y = l0.p.y - l1.p.y;ret.z = l0.p.z - l1.p.z;// this solution is from: http://local.wasp.uwa.edu.au/~pbourke/geometry/lineline3d/ double dv01v1 = MiscOps.dot (ret,l1.slope);double dv1v0 = MiscOps.dot (l1.slope,l0.slope);double dv1v1 = MiscOps.dot (l1.slope,l1.slope);double t0 = dv01v1 * dv1v0 - MiscOps.dot (ret,l0.slope) * dv1v1;double bottom = MiscOps.dot (l0.slope,l0.slope) * dv1v1 - dv1v0 * dv1v0;if (bottom == 0) return null;t0 /= bottom;// ( d1343 + mua d4321 ) / d4343 double t1 = (dv01v1 + t0 * dv1v0) / dv1v1;ret.x = (double) 0.5 * ((l0.p.x + t0 * l0.slope.x) + (l1.p.x + t1 * l1.slope.x));ret.y = (double) 0.5 * ((l0.p.y + t0 * l0.slope.y) + (l1.p.y + t1 * l1.slope.y));ret.z = (double) 0.5 * ((l0.p.z + t0 * l0.slope.z) + (l1.p.z + t1 * l1.slope.z));return ret;}

originalComment: Finds the closest point on a line to the specified point.
codeComment: This method calculates the closest point on a 3D line to a given point. It takes a line defined by a point and a direction vector, a target point, and a return point. If the return point is null, it creates a new one. The method computes the distance from the target point to the line and then calculates the closest point on the line by projecting the target point onto the line's direction vector. The result is stored in the return point and returned.
codeFunctions: public static Point3D_F64 closestPoint (LineParametric3D_F64 line,Point3D_F64 pt,Point3D_F64 ret) { if (ret == null) { ret = new Point3D_F64 ();} double dx = pt.x - line.p.x;double dy = pt.y - line.p.y;double dz = pt.z - line.p.z;double n2 = line.slope.normSq ();double d = (line.slope.x * dx + line.slope.y * dy + line.slope.z * dz);ret.x = line.p.x + d * line.slope.x / n2;ret.y = line.p.y + d * line.slope.y / n2;ret.z = line.p.z + d * line.slope.z / n2;return ret;}

originalComment: Finds the closest point on the plane to the origin.
codeComment: This method calculates the closest point on a plane to the origin (0, 0, 0) and returns it. It takes a `PlaneGeneral3D_F64` object and a `Point3D_F64` object as input. If the input point is `null`, it initializes a new `Point3D_F64` object. The method then calculates the squared norm of the plane's normal vector and uses it to compute the coordinates of the closest point on the plane to the origin. Finally, it returns the computed point.
codeFunctions: public static Point3D_F64 closestPointOrigin (PlaneGeneral3D_F64 plane,Point3D_F64 found) { if (found == null) found = new Point3D_F64 ();double n2 = plane.A * plane.A + plane.B * plane.B + plane.C * plane.C;found.x = plane.A * plane.D / n2;found.y = plane.B * plane.D / n2;found.z = plane.C * plane.D / n2;return found;}

originalComment: Finds the closest point on a line segment to the specified point.
codeComment: This method calculates the closest point on a line segment to a given point. It first checks if the return point is null and initializes it if necessary. Then, it calculates the direction vector of the line segment and the vector from the start point of the line segment to the given point. The method computes the distance from the start point to the given point along the line segment and checks if the point is past the end points. If it is, the method returns one of the end points. Otherwise, it calculates the closest point on the line segment and returns it.
codeFunctions: public static Point3D_F64 closestPoint (LineSegment3D_F64 line,Point3D_F64 pt,Point3D_F64 ret) { if (ret == null) { ret = new Point3D_F64 ();} double dx = pt.x - line.a.x;double dy = pt.y - line.a.y;double dz = pt.z - line.a.z;double slope_x = line.b.x - line.a.x;double slope_y = line.b.y - line.a.y;double slope_z = line.b.z - line.a.z;double n = (double) Math.sqrt (slope_x * slope_x + slope_y * slope_y + slope_z * slope_z);double d = (slope_x * dx + slope_y * dy + slope_z * dz) / n;// if it is past the end points just return one of the end points if (d <= 0) { ret.set (line.a);} else if (d >= n) { ret.set (line.b);} else { ret.x = line.a.x + d * slope_x / n;ret.y = line.a.y + d * slope_y / n;ret.z = line.a.z + d * slope_z / n;} return ret;}

codeFunctions: public static void transform (Se2_F64 se,Point2D_F64 points [ ],int length) { double tranX = se.getX ();double tranY = se.getY ();final double c = se.getCosineYaw ();final double s = se.getSineYaw ();for (int i = 0;i < length;i ++) { Point2D_F64 pt = points [ i ];double x = pt.x;double y = pt.y;pt.x = tranX + x * c - y * s;pt.y = tranY + x * s + y * c;} }

codeFunctions: public static double acuteAngle (LineGeneral2D_F64 a,LineGeneral2D_F64 b) { double la = Math.sqrt (a.A * a.A + a.B * a.B);double lb = Math.sqrt (b.A * b.A + b.B * b.B);// numerical round off error can cause it to be barely greater than 1, which is outside the allowed // domain of acos() double value = (a.A * b.A + a.B * b.B) / (la * lb);if (value < - 1.0) value = - 1.0;else if (value > 1.0) value = 1.0;return Math.acos (value);}

If the signs are the same, it adds the areas of the two triangles formed by the vertices. If the signs are different, it adds the areas of the two triangles formed by the vertices in the opposite order.
codeFunctions: public static double quadrilateral (Quadrilateral_F64 quad) { double bx = quad.b.x - quad.a.x;double by = quad.b.y - quad.a.y;double cx = quad.c.x - quad.a.x;double cy = quad.c.y - quad.a.y;double dx = quad.d.x - quad.a.x;double dy = quad.d.y - quad.a.y;if ((bx * cy - by * cx >= 0) == (cx * dy - cy * dx >= 0)) { return triangle (quad.a,quad.b,quad.c) + triangle (quad.a,quad.c,quad.d);} else { return triangle (quad.a,quad.b,quad.d) + triangle (quad.b,quad.c,quad.d);} }

codeComment: This method calculates the area of a polygon using the shoelace formula. codeFunctions: public static double polygonSimple (Polygon2D_F64 poly) { double total = 0;Point2D_F64 v0 = poly.get (0);Point2D_F64 v1 = poly.get (1);for (int i = 2;i < poly.size ();i ++) { Point2D_F64 v2 = poly.get (i);total += v1.x * (v2.y - v0.y);v0 = v1;v1 = v2;} Point2D_F64 v2 = poly.get (0);total += v1.x * (v2.y - v0.y);v0 = v1;v1 = v2;v2 = poly.get (1);total += v1.x * (v2.y - v0.y);return Math.abs (total / 2.0);}

originalComment: Determines if the polugon is convex or concave.

Skipping its server features.");debug (e);return result;} File [ ] configDropinsXmls = configDropinsFolder.listFiles (new FilenameFilter () { @ Override public boolean accept (File dir,String name) { return name.endsWith (".xml");} });if (configDropinsXmls == null || configDropinsXmls.length == 0) { return result;} // sort the files in alphabetical order so that overrides will happen in the proper order Comparator < File > comparator = new Comparator < File > () { @ Override public int compare (File left,File right) { return left.getAbsolutePath ().toLowerCase ().compareTo (right.getAbsolutePath ().toLowerCase ());} };Collections.sort (Arrays.asList (configDropinsXmls),comparator);for (File xml:configDropinsXmls) { Set < String > features = getServerXmlFeatures (result,xml,null);if (features != null) { result = features;} } return result;}

Skipping its features.");debug (e);return result;} updatedParsedXmls.add (canonicalServerFile);if (canonicalServerFile.exists ()) { try { Document doc = new XmlDocument () { public Document getDocument (File file) throws IOException,ParserConfigurationException,SAXException { createDocument (file);return doc;} }.getDocument (canonicalServerFile);Element root = doc.getDocumentElement ();NodeList nodes = root.getChildNodes ();for (int i = 0;i < nodes.getLength ();i ++) { if (nodes.item (i) instanceof Element) { Element child = (Element) nodes.item (i);if ("featureManager".equals (child.getNodeName ())) { if (result == null) { result = new HashSet < String > ();} result.addAll (parseFeatureManagerNode (child));} else if ("include".equals (child.getNodeName ())) { result = parseIncludeNode (result,canonicalServerFile,child,updatedParsedXmls);} } } } catch (IOException | ParserConfigurationException | SAXException e) { // just skip this server.xml if it cannot be parsed warn ("The server file " + serverFile + " cannot be parsed. originalComment: subrange - allocate new subcolors to this range of chars fill in arcs.The range will overlap existing ranges;even in the simplest case it will overlap the initial WHITE range.For each existing range that it overlaps allocate a new color mark the range as mapping to that color and add an arc between the states for that color.
codeComment: This method takes a range of integers and a pair of states, and generates new arcs in a compiler's NFA (Non-deterministic Finite Automaton) based on the specified range. It avoids multiple calls to the `map.get()` method by using a sub-range map. The method creates a list of ranges from the map, processes each range, and allocates a new subcolor for each range. The subcolor is then used to create new arcs in the NFA, with the start and end points adjusted based on the bounds of the range.
codeFunctions:
void subrange (int from,int to,State lp,State rp) throws RegexException { /* Avoid one call to map.get() for each character in the range.
         * This map will usually contain one item, but in complex cases more.
         * For example, if we had [a-f][g-h] and then someone asked for [f-g], there
         * would be two. Each of these new ranges will get a new color via subcolor.
         */ Map < Range < Integer >,Short > curColors = map.subRangeMap (Range.closed (from,to)).asMapOfRanges ();/*
         * To avoid concurrent mod problems, we need to copy the ranges we are working from.
         */ List < Range < Integer > > ranges = Lists.newArrayList (curColors.keySet ());for (Range < Integer > rangeToProcess:ranges) { // bound management here irritating. int start = rangeToProcess.lowerEndpoint ();if (rangeToProcess.lowerBoundType () == BoundType.OPEN) { start ++;} int end = rangeToProcess.upperEndpoint ();if (rangeToProcess.upperBoundType () == BoundType.CLOSED) { end ++;} // allocate a new subcolor and account it owning the entire range. short color = subcolor (start,end - start);compiler.getNfa ().newarc (Compiler.PLAIN,color,lp,rp);} }

originalComment: okcolors - promote subcolors to full colors
codeComment: This method processes a list of `ColorDesc` objects associated with an `Nfa` (Non-deterministic Finite Automaton). It iterates through each `ColorDesc`, checking if it has a subcolor. If the subcolor is not used, it skips to the next one. If the subcolor is the same as the current color, it marks the subcolor as unused and continues. If the parent color is empty, it changes the arcs of the current color to the subcolor and updates the subcolor of the subcolor. If the parent color is not empty, it creates new arcs with the subcolor for each arc of the current color and updates the subcolor of the subcolor. Finally, it frees the current color.
codeFunctions: void okcolors (Nfa nfa) { ColorDesc cd;ColorDesc scd;Arc a;short sco;for (short co = 0;co < colorDescs.size ();co ++) { cd = colorDescs.get (co);if (cd == null) { continue;// not in use at all, so can't have a subcolor. } sco = cd.sub;if (sco == Constants.NOSUB) { /* has no subcolor, no further action */ } else if (sco == co) { /* is subcolor, let parent deal with it */ } else if (cd.getNChars () == 0) { /* parent empty, its arcs change color to subcolor */ cd.sub = Constants.NOSUB;scd = colorDescs.get (sco);assert scd.getNChars () > 0;assert scd.sub == sco;scd.sub = Constants.NOSUB;while ((a = cd.arcs) != null) { assert a.co == co;cd.arcs = a.colorchain;a.setColor (sco);a.colorchain = scd.arcs;scd.arcs = a;} freecolor (co);} else { /* parent's arcs must gain parallel subcolor arcs */ cd.sub = Constants.NOSUB;scd = colorDescs.get (sco);assert scd.getNChars () > 0;assert scd.sub == sco;scd.sub = Constants.NOSUB;for (a = cd.arcs;a != null;a = a.colorchain) { assert a.co == co;nfa.newarc (a.type,sco,a.from,a.to);} } } }

originalComment: uncolorchain - delete this arc from the color chain of its color
codeComment: This method `uncolorchain` takes an `Arc` object `a` as input and removes it from the color chain of its associated `ColorDesc` object. If `a` is the only element in the color chain, it simply sets the `arcs` field of the `ColorDesc` object to `null`. If `a` is not the only element, it iterates through the color chain until it finds the element before `a` and sets its `colorchain` field to `a.colorchain`. Finally, it sets the `colorchain` field of `a` to `null` to ensure that it is not part of any color chain.
codeFunctions: void uncolorchain (Arc a) { ColorDesc cd = colorDescs.get (a.co);Arc aa;aa = cd.arcs;if (aa == a) { /* easy case */ cd.arcs = a.colorchain;} else { for (;aa != null && aa.colorchain != a;aa = aa.colorchain) { // } assert aa != null;aa.colorchain = a.colorchain;} a.colorchain = null;/* paranoia */ }

originalComment: lexstart - set up lexical stuff scan leading options
codeComment: The `lexstart` method initializes the lexer by setting the appropriate token type based on the flags in the `v.cflags` variable. It checks for the presence of `Flags.REG_QUOTE`, `Flags.REG_EXTENDED`, or `Flags.REG_ADVANCED` flags and sets the token type accordingly. If none of these flags are set, it defaults to `Flags.REG_BRE`. The method then resets the `v.nexttype` to `Compiler.EMPTY` and proceeds to set up the first token.
codeFunctions: void lexstart () throws RegexException { prefixes ();/* may turn on new type bits etc. */ if (0 != (v.cflags & Flags.REG_QUOTE)) { assert 0 == (v.cflags & (Flags.REG_ADVANCED | Flags.REG_EXPANDED | Flags.REG_NEWLINE));intocon (L_Q);} else if (0 != (v.cflags & Flags.REG_EXTENDED)) { assert 0 == (v.cflags & Flags.REG_QUOTE);intocon (L_ERE);} else { assert 0 == (v.cflags & (Flags.REG_QUOTE | Flags.REG_ADVF));intocon (L_BRE);} v.nexttype = Compiler.EMPTY;/* remember we were at the start */ next ();/* set up the first token */ }

originalComment: prefixes - implement various special prefixes
codeComment: This method processes regular expression options in a string. It checks for special prefixes like "***", "***=", "***:", and embedded options like "AREs" and "BREs". It sets flags based on the options found and throws exceptions for invalid patterns.
codeFunctions:
void prefixes () throws RegexException { /* literal string doesn't get any of this stuff */ if (0 != (v.cflags & Flags.REG_QUOTE)) { return;} /* initial "***" gets special things */ if (have (4) && next3 (' ',' ',' ')) { switch (charAtNowPlus (3)) { case ' ':/* "***?" error, msg shows version */ throw new RegexException ("REG_BADPAT");case ' ':/* "***=" shifts to literal string */ v.note (Flags.REG_UNONPOSIX);v.cflags |= Flags.REG_QUOTE;v.cflags &= ~ (Flags.REG_ADVANCED | Flags.REG_EXPANDED | Flags.REG_NEWLINE);v.now += 4;return;/* and there can be no more prefixes */ case ' ':/* "***:" shifts to AREs */ v.note (Flags.REG_UNONPOSIX);v.cflags |= Flags.REG_ADVANCED;v.now += 4;break;default:/* otherwise *** is just an error */ throw new RegexException ("REG_BADRPT");} } /* BREs and EREs don't get embedded options */ if ((v.cflags & Flags.REG_ADVANCED) != Flags.REG_ADVANCED) { return;} /* embedded options (AREs only) */ if (have (3) && next2 (' ',' ') && iscalpha (charAtNowPlus (2))) { v.note (Flags.REG_UNONPOSIX);v.now += 2;for (;!ateos () && iscalpha (charAtNow ());v.now ++) { switch (charAtNow ()) { case ' ':/* BREs (but why???) */ v.cflags &= ~ (Flags.REG_ADVANCED | Flags.REG_QUOTE);break;case ' ':/* case sensitive */ v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_ICASE;break;case ' ':/* plain EREs */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_EXTENDED;v.cflags &= ~ (Flags.REG_ADVF | Flags.REG_QUOTE);break;case ' ':/* case insensitive */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_ICASE;break;case ' ':/* Perloid synonym for n */ case ' ':/* 
 affects ^ $ . [^ */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_NEWLINE;break;case ' ':/* ~Perl, 
 affects . [^ */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_NLSTOP;v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_NLANCH;break;case ' ':/* literal string */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_QUOTE;v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_ADVANCED;break;case ' ':/* single line, 
 ordinary */ v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_NEWLINE;break;case ' ':/* tight syntax */ v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_EXPANDED;break;case ' ':/* weird, 
 affects ^ $ only */ v.cflags &= ~ Flags.REG_NLSTOP;v.cflags |= Flags.REG_NLANCH;break;case ' ':/* expanded syntax */ v.cflags |= Flags.REG_EXPANDED;break;default:throw new RegexException ("REG_BADOPT");} } if (!next1 (' ')) { throw new RegexException ("REG_BADOPT");} v.now ++;if (0 != (v.cflags & Flags.REG_QUOTE)) { v.cflags &= ~ (Flags.REG_EXPANDED | Flags.REG_NEWLINE);} } }

originalComment: lexnest - call a subroutine interpolating string at the lexical level Note this is not a very general facility.There are a number of implicit assumptions about what sorts of strings can be subroutines.
codeComment:
The function `lexnest` takes a character array `interpolated` as input and performs the following operations:

1. It asserts that `v.savepattern` is `null`, indicating that there is only one level of nesting.
2. It saves the current values of `v.savepattern`, `v.savenow`, `v.savestop`, and `v.now` into `v.savepattern`, `v.savenow`, `v.savestop`, and `v.now` respectively.
3. It sets `v.pattern` to the `interpolated` array.
4. It resets `v.now` to `0`.
5. It sets `v.stop` to the length of `v.pattern`.

This function appears to be used to prepare for a new pattern or interpolation, potentially in a context where patterns are nested or need to be saved and restored.
codeFunctions: void lexnest (char [ ] interpolated) { assert v.savepattern == null;/* only one level of nesting */ v.savepattern = v.pattern;v.savenow = v.now;v.savestop = v.stop;v.savenow = v.now;v.pattern = interpolated;v.now = 0;v.stop = v.pattern.length;}

If the map does not contain the specified `codepoint`, it throws a `RuntimeException` with a message indicating that the `codepoint` has no mapping.

originalComment: Called at the start of a match.arguably we could just construct a new DFA each time.
codeComment: This method initializes a new `StateSet` object with the given `start` state. It clears any existing state sets, creates a new `StateSet` with the specified number of states and colors, sets the initial state, marks it as having no progress, inserts it into a hash table based on its initial state, and sets the last seen state to the given `start` state. Finally, it returns the newly created `StateSet` object.
codeFunctions: StateSet initialize (int start) { // Discard state sets; reuse would be faster if we kept them, // but then we'd need the real cache. stateSets.clear ();StateSet stateSet = new StateSet (nstates,ncolors);stateSet.states.set (cnfa.pre);stateSet.noprogress = true;// Insert into hash table based on that one state. stateSets.put (stateSet.states,stateSet);stateSet.setLastSeen (start);return stateSet;}

originalComment: lastcold - determine last point at which no progress had been made
codeComment: The function `lastcold` returns the last time any state set in the `stateSets` map had no progress. It iterates over each state set, checks if it has no progress (`ss.noprogress`), and if its last seen time (`ss.getLastSeen()`) is greater than the current maximum last seen time (`nopr`). If so, it updates `nopr` with the current last seen time. Finally, it returns the maximum last seen time found.
codeFunctions: int lastcold () { int nopr = 0;for (StateSet ss:stateSets.values ()) { if (ss.noprogress && nopr < ss.getLastSeen ()) { nopr = ss.getLastSeen ();} } return nopr;}

originalComment: eclass - Because we have no MCCE support this just processing single characters.
codeComment: This method checks if a given character `c` should be included in a UnicodeSet based on a boolean flag `cases`. If `cases` is true, it returns the `allcases` set, which contains all characters that match the given character in terms of case. If `cases` is false, it creates a new UnicodeSet containing only the given character.
codeFunctions: static UnicodeSet eclass (char c,boolean cases) { /* otherwise, none */ if (cases) { return allcases (c);} else { UnicodeSet set = new UnicodeSet ();set.add (c);return set;} }

originalComment: Return a UnicodeSet for a character class name.It appears that the names that TCL accepts are also acceptable to ICU.
codeComment: This method retrieves a UnicodeSet based on the given class name and case sensitivity. If case sensitivity is enabled, it retrieves the set from the `KNOWN_SETS_CI` map; otherwise, it retrieves the set from the `KNOWN_SETS_CS` map. If an `ExecutionException` occurs, it propagates the cause if it is an instance of `RegexException`, otherwise, it throws a `RegexRuntimeException` with the cause.
codeFunctions: public static UnicodeSet cclass (String cclassName,boolean casefold) throws RegexException { try { if (casefold) { return KNOWN_SETS_CI.get (cclassName);} else { return KNOWN_SETS_CS.get (cclassName);} } catch (ExecutionException e) { Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf (e.getCause (),RegexException.class);throw new RegexRuntimeException (e.getCause ());} }

originalComment: carcsort - sort compacted - NFA arcs by color Really dumb algorithm but if the list is long enough for that to matter you re in real trouble anyway.
codeComment: The `carcsort` function sorts an array of arcs based on their color and target. It uses a nested loop to compare each pair of arcs and swaps them if the first arc's color is greater than the second's, or if the colors are equal but the first arc's target is greater than the second's. The function uses the `Cnfa.carcColor` and `Cnfa.carcTarget` methods to get the color and target of each arc, respectively. The function returns early if the array has one or zero elements.
codeFunctions: void carcsort (int first,int last) { int p;int q;long tmp;if (last - first <= 1) { return;} for (p = first;p <= last;p ++) { for (q = p;q <= last;q ++) { short pco = Cnfa.carcColor (arcs [ p ]);short qco = Cnfa.carcColor (arcs [ q ]);int pto = Cnfa.carcTarget (arcs [ p ]);int qto = Cnfa.carcTarget (arcs [ q ]);if (pco > qco || (pco == qco && pto > qto)) { assert p != q;tmp = arcs [ p ];arcs [ p ] = arcs [ q ];arcs [ q ] = tmp;} } } }

originalComment: dumpst - dump a subRE tree
codeComment: This method generates a string representation of a node in a regular expression parser. It constructs a string that includes the node's ID, operator, flags, and other relevant information. The method appends this string to a `StringBuilder` and returns the final string. It also recursively calls itself for the left and right children of the node if they exist.
codeFunctions: String dumpst (boolean nfapresent) { StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder ();sb.append (String.format ("%s. `%c'",shortId (),op));if (0 != (flags & LONGER)) { sb.append (" longest");} if (0 != (flags & SHORTER)) { sb.append (" shortest");} if (0 != (flags & MIXED)) { sb.append (" hasmixed");} if (0 != (flags & CAP)) { sb.append (" hascapture");} if (0 != (flags & BACKR)) { sb.append (" hasbackref");} if (0 == (flags & INUSE)) { sb.append (" UNUSED");} if (subno != 0) { sb.append (String.format (" (#%d)",subno));} if (min != 1 || max != 1) { sb.append (String.format (" {%d,",min));if (max != Compiler.INFINITY) { sb.append (String.format ("%d",max));} sb.append ("}");} if (nfapresent) { sb.append (String.format (" %d-%d",begin.no,end.no));} if (left != null) { sb.append (String.format (" L:%s",left.toString ()));} if (right != null) { sb.append (String.format (" R:%s",right.toString ()));} sb.append ("\n");if (left != null) { left.dumpst (nfapresent);} if (right != null) { right.dumpst (nfapresent);} return sb.toString ();}

originalComment: Factory method for new states.
codeComment: This method creates a new `State` object, assigns it a unique number, and adds it to a linked list of states. If the list is empty, it initializes the list with the new state. If the list is not empty, it appends the new state to the end of the list and updates the `slast` pointer. The method also sets the `flag` of the new state.
codeFunctions: State newstate (int flag) { State newState = new State ();newState.no = nstates ++;// a unique number. if (states == null) { states = newState;} if (slast != null) { assert slast.next == null;slast.next = newState;} newState.prev = slast;slast = newState;newState.flag = flag;return newState;}

originalComment: moveouts - move all out arcs of a state to another state
codeComment: The `moveouts` function takes two `State` objects, `old` and `newState`, as input. It asserts that `old` is not equal to `newState`. The function then enters a loop that continues as long as there are outgoing arcs (`outs`) from the `old` state. In each iteration, it calls the `cparc` function to copy the arc to the `newState` and the `freearc` function to free the original arc. This process effectively moves all outgoing arcs from the `old` state to the `newState`.
codeFunctions: void moveouts (State old,State newState) { Arc a;assert old != newState;while ((a = old.outs) != null) { cparc (a,newState,a.to);freearc (a);} }

originalComment: moveins - move all in arcs of a state to another state You might think this could be done better by just updating the existing arcs and you would be right if it weren t for the desire for duplicate suppression which makes it easier to just make new ones to exploit the suppression built into newarc.
codeComment: The function `moveins` takes two `State` objects, `old` and `newState`, as input. It iterates through the arcs in the `old` state, updating the `from` state of each arc to `newState` and then freeing the arc. After the loop, it asserts that the number of incoming arcs in `old` is zero and that `old.ins` is null.
codeFunctions: void moveins (State old,State newState) { Arc a;assert old != newState;while ((a = old.ins) != null) { cparc (a,a.from,newState);freearc (a);} assert old.nins == 0;assert old.ins == null;}

originalComment: copyins - copy all in arcs of a state to another state
codeComment: The `copyins` function takes two `State` objects, `old` and `newState`, and copies all incoming arcs from `old` to `newState`. It iterates through each incoming arc in `old`, creates a copy of the arc, and sets the `from` state of the copy to `newState`. The function assumes that `old` and `newState` are not the same object.
codeFunctions: void copyins (State old,State newState) { Arc a;assert old != newState;for (a = old.ins;a != null;a = a.inchain) { cparc (a,a.from,newState);} }

originalComment: copyouts - copy all out arcs of a state to another state
codeComment: The `copyouts` function takes two `State` objects, `old` and `newState`, and copies all outgoing arcs from `old` to `newState`. It iterates through the outgoing arcs of `old`, creating new arcs in `newState` that point to the same destinations as the original arcs. The function assumes that `old` and `newState` are not the same object.
codeFunctions: void copyouts (State old,State newState) { Arc a;assert old != newState;for (a = old.outs;a != null;a = a.outchain) { cparc (a,newState,a.to);} }

originalComment: get rid of a state releasing all its arcs.I m not sure that all this is needed as opposed to depending on the GC.
codeComment:
The `dropstate` function takes a `State` object `s` as input and performs the following operations:

1. It initializes an `Arc` object `a`.
2. It enters a while loop that continues as long as `s.ins` is not null. In each iteration of the loop, it calls the `freearc` function with `a` as the argument.
3. It enters another while loop that continues as long as `s.outs` is not null. In each iteration of the loop, it calls the `freearc` function with `a` as the argument.
4. After both while loops have finished, it calls the `freestate` function with `s` as the argument.
codeFunctions: void dropstate (State s) { Arc a;while ((a = s.ins) != null) { freearc (a);} while ((a = s.outs) != null) { freearc (a);} freestate (s);}

originalComment: Unwire a state from the NFA.
codeComment: This method `freestate` is designed to free a state object from a linked list. It first checks if the state is not null and that it has no inputs or outputs. If the state has a next state, it updates the previous state's next pointer to skip over the current state. If the state is the last state in the list, it updates the `slast` pointer to point to the previous state. If the state has a previous state, it updates the next state's previous pointer to skip over the current state. If the state is the first state in the list, it updates the `states` pointer to point to the next state.

codeComment: The function `fixempties` iteratively finds and eliminates empty arcs in a finite state machine (NFA) until no more empty arcs are found. originalComment: Updates the state and reps for the current byte in the opts array.
codeComment: This method updates the optimization state and repetition count for a given position in an array. If the previous position is a literal, it updates the state to match the previous state and then updates the literal count. If the previous position is a repetition, it updates the state to match the state of the previous repetition and then updates the repetition count. If the previous position is the same as the current position minus one, it updates the state based on whether the back pointer is zero or negative one. originalComment: Calculates prices of a literal a short rep and literal + rep0.
codeComment: This method calculates the best price for a single byte in a compression process. It considers three options: a literal, a short repetition, and a literal followed by a long repetition. The method updates the best price and state for the next position based on these options.

codeComment: This method calculates the optimal long repetition prices for a given position in a text. codeComment: This method calculates normal match prices for a given position, position state, available space, any match price, and start length. codeComment: The function `movePos` takes two integer parameters, `requiredForFlushing` and `requiredForFinishing`. codeComment: This method takes a `RollupType` and a `Granularity` as input and returns a `Rollup.Type` based on the combination of these inputs. It uses a switch statement to handle different `RollupType` values and returns the corresponding `Rollup.Type` for each case. If the input `RollupType` is not recognized, it throws an `IllegalArgumentException` with a message indicating that rollups cannot be computed for the given type and granularity.
codeFunctions: public static Rollup.Type getRollupComputer (RollupType srcType,Granularity srcGran) { switch (srcType) { case COUNTER:return Rollup.CounterFromCounter;case TIMER:return Rollup.TimerFromTimer;case GAUGE:return Rollup.GaugeFromGauge;case BF_BASIC:return srcGran == Granularity.FULL?Rollup.BasicFromRaw:Rollup.BasicFromBasic;case SET:return Rollup.SetFromSet;default:break;} throw new IllegalArgumentException (String.format ("Cannot compute rollups for %s from %s",srcType.name (),srcGran.shortName ()));}

originalComment: Helper function to build the ttl mapping.Only insert to the mapping if the value is a valid date.
codeComment: This method attempts to set a time-to-live (TTL) configuration for a specific granularity and rollup type in an `ImmutableTable.Builder`.
